sections.title: The prophecy that was spoken in Judah.

verses.text: በይሁዳ ነገሥታት በዖዝያንና በኢዮአታም፥ በአካዝና በሕዝቅያስ ዘመን ስለ ይሁዳና ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ያየው የአሞጽ ልጅ የኢሳይያስ ራእይ።
እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ተናግሮአልና፥ “ሰማይ ስማ፤ ምድርም አድምጪ፤ ልጆችን ወለድሁ፤ አሳደግሁም፤ እነርሱም ዐመፁብኝ።
በሬ ገዢውን አህያም የጌታውን ጋጥ ዐወቀ፤ እስራኤል ግን አላወቁኝም፤ ሕዝቤም አላስተዋሉኝም።”
ኀጢአተኛ ወገንና ዐመፅ የተሞላበት ሕዝብ፥ የክፉዎች ዘር፥ በደለኞች ልጆች ሆይ፥ ወዮላችሁ! እግዚአብሔርን ተዋችሁት፤ የእስራኤልንም ቅዱስ አስቈጣችሁት።
እንግዲህ በበደል ላይ በደል እየጨመራችሁ ለምን ትቀሠፋላችሁ? ራስ ሁሉ ለሕማም፥ ልብም ሁሉ ለኀዘን ሆኖአል።
ከእግር ጫማ አንሥቶ እስከ ራስ ድረስ ጤና የለውም፤ ቍስልና እበጥ የሚመግልም ነው፤ አልፈረጠም፤ አልተጠገነምም፤ በዘይትም አልለዘበም።
ምድራችሁ ባድማ ናት፤ ከተሞቻችሁ በእሳት ተቃጠሉ፤ እርሻችሁንም በፊታችሁ ባዕዳን ይበሉታል፤ ጠላትም ያጠፋዋል፤ ባድማም ያደርገዋል።
የጽዮንም ሴት ልጅ በወይን ቦታ እንዳለ ዳስ፥ እንደ አዝመራ ጠባቂም ጎጆ፥ እንደ ተከበበችም ከተማ ሆና ቀረች።
የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ዘርን ባያስቀርልን ኖሮ፥ እንደ ሰዶም በሆንን፥ እንደ ገሞራም በመሰልን ነበር።
እናንተ የሰዶም አለቆች ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ እናንተ የገሞራ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ አድምጡ።

"What is the multitude of your sacrifices to Me?" saith the Lord; "I am full of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats."

"When ye come to appear before Me, who hath required this at your hand to tread My courts? Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto Me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting."

"Though ye offer Me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts. Take thou away from Me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols."
"But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream. Have ye offered unto Me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?"
"Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon."
"Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before Mine eyes; cease to do evil."
"Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow."
"Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool."
"If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land."
"But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it."

sections.title: The city that is filled with sin.

verses.text: ፍርድ መልቶባት የነበረ የታመነችይቱ የጽዮን ከተማ እንዴት ጋለሞታ ሆነች! ጽድቅ አድሮባት ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ወንበዴዎችና ነፍሰ ገዳዮች አሉባት።
ወርቅሽና ብርሽ ዛገ፥ የወይን ጠጅ አሳላፊዎችሽም በወይን ጠጅሽ ላይ ውኃን ይደባልቃሉ።
አለቆችሽ ዐመፀኞችና የሌቦች ባልንጀሮች ሆኑ፤ ሁሉ ጉቦ ይወድዳሉ፤ ፍርድንም ሊያጣምሙ ይፈልጋሉ፤ ለሙት ልጅ አይፈርዱም፤ የመበለቲቱንም አቤቱታ አያዳምጡም።
ስለዚህ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “ለእስራኤል ኀያላን ወዮላቸው! በጠላቶች ላይ ቍጣዬ አይበርድም፤ ጠላቶችንም እበቀላለሁ።
እጄንም በአንቺ ላይ አመጣለሁ፤ አግልሻለሁ፤ ዝገትሽንም አነጻለሁ፤ ቆርቆሮሽንም ሁሉ አስወግዳለሁ፤ ዐመፀኞችን አጠፋለሁ፤ ሕገ ወጦችንም ከአንቺ አስወግዳለሁ፤ ትዕቢተኞችንም አዋርዳለሁ።
ፈራጆችሽንም እንደ ቀድሞ፥ አማካሪዎችሽንም እንደ መጀመሪያ ጊዜ አስነሣለሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ የጽድቅ ከተማ፥ የታመነችም ጽዮን ርእሰ ከተማ ተብለሽ ትጠሪያለሽ።
ምርኮኞችሽ በእውነትና በምጽዋት ይድናሉ።
በደለኞችና ኀጢአተኞች ግን በአንድነት ይቀጠቀጣሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚተዉት ሁሉ ይጠፋሉ።
በወደዱአቸው ጣዖታት ያፍራሉና፥ በፈለጉአቸውም የአድባር ዛፎች ዕፍረት ይይዛቸዋልና፤
ቅጠልዋ እንደ ረገፈ የጠርቤንቶስ ዛፍ፥ ውኃም እንደሌለበት የአትክልት ቦታ ይሆናሉና።

Their strength shall be as the strength of the locust, and their work shall be as the work of the caterpillar; they shall consume both the mighty and the strong together; and the fire shall devour them.

sections.title: Concerning the house of the Lord.

verses.text: The word that came to Isaiah the son of Amoz concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

And it shall come to pass in the latter days, that the mountain of the house of the Lord shall be established on the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.

For the law shall go forth from Zion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem; and many peoples shall come and say, “Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and He will teach us of His ways, and we will walk in His paths.”

And He shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks; nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war anymore.
Now, O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the Lord.

For the people of Jacob are filled with the land; their land is full of silver and gold, and there is no end to their treasures; their land is also full of horses, and there is no end to their chariots.
Their land is filled with idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.
And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself; therefore forgive them not.
And now, when the earth is shaken, and the mountains are moved, let them enter into the rocks and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the Lord and for the glory of His majesty.
When He ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
የትዕቢተኞች ሰዎች ዐይኖች ይዋረዳሉ፤ የሰዎችም ኵራት ትወድቃለች፥ በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ብቻ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።
የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቀን በትዕቢተኛውና በኵራተኛው ሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ባለውም ላይ ይሆናል፤ እነርሱም ይዋረዳሉ፤
ደግሞም በረጅሙ ከፍ ባለውም በሊባኖስ ዝግባ ሁሉ ላይ፥ በባሳንም ዛፍ ሁሉ ላይ፥
በረጅሙም ተራራ ሁሉ ላይ፥ ከፍ ባለውም ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ፥
በረጅሙም ግንብ ሁሉ ላይ፥ በተመሸገውም ቅጥር ሁሉ ላይ፥
በባሕሩም መርከብ ሁሉ ላይ፥ በተጌጡ ጣዖታትም ምስል ሁሉ ላይ ይሆናል።
ሰውም ሁሉ ይዋረዳል፤ የሰውም ኵራት ይወድቃል፤ በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ብቻ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።
በእጅ የተሠሩ ጣዖታትን ሁሉ ይሰውራሉ፤
እግዚአብሔርም ምድርን ያናውጥ ዘንድ በተነሣ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን ከመፍራትና ከግርማው ክብር የተነሣ ወደ ድንጋይ ዋሻና ወደ ምድር ንቃቃት ውስጥ ያገቡአቸዋል።
በዚያም ቀን ሰው ይሰግድላቸው ዘንድ ያበጁአቸውን የብሩንና የወርቁን ጣዖቶቹን ለፍልፈልና ለሌሊት ወፍ ይጥላል።
እግዚአብሔርም ምድርን ያናውጥ ዘንድ በተነሣ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን ከመፍራትና ከግርማው ክብር የተነሣ ወደ ድንጋይ ዋሻና ወደ ተሰነጠቁ ዓለቶች ውስጥ ያገባሉ።
እስትንፋሱ በአፍንጫው ያለበትን ሰው ተዉት፤ እርሱ ስለ ምን ይቈጠራል?

sections.title: Concerning the assault that shall come upon Jerusalem.

verses.text: Behold, the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, shall remove the mighty man and the mighty woman from Jerusalem and from Judah, the strength of the mighty, and the strength of the waters shall He take away.
The valiant man, the warrior, the judge, the prophet, the wise man, and the elder,
The captain of fifty, and the honorable man, and the counselor, and the skilled artisan, and the eloquent orator, He shall remove.
And I will make their leaders to be as children, and their rulers shall be as women.
The people shall oppress one another, and every man his neighbor; the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honorable.
And a man shall take hold of his brother, of the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”
In that day shall he lift up his voice, saying, “I have no bread nor clothing in my house; I shall not be a ruler of the people.”
Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against the Lord, to provoke the eyes of His glory.
Today their glory is consumed, and their faces are ashamed; their sin is as the sin of Sodom and as the sin of Gomorrah; they are utterly known.
Woe unto them that call evil good and good evil! They say, “Let us oppress the righteous, for we are strong,” therefore the fruit of their hands shall be consumed.
As the work of His hand is done, so shall it be rendered unto you; woe unto the wicked! Evil shall befall them.

O my people, your rulers have distressed you; the oppressors, even women, shall rule over you. O my people, they who give you thanks shall be few; they shall cause you to lose the way in which you should walk.

sections.title: The Lord shall judge upon His people.

verses.text: Nevertheless, the Lord shall rise today for judgment; He shall arise to judge His people.
The Lord shall come forth for judgment against the rulers and the leaders of His people; and He shall say, "I have stripped you bare; the poor whom you have oppressed is in your house."
"Why do you oppress My people? Why do you strike the face of the poor?"

sections.title: A Warning Given to the Women of Jerusalem

verses.text: The Lord said, “Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with outstretched necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, making a tinkling with their feet;
Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the Lord will uncover their secret parts in that day.
In that day the Lord will take away the finery of the anklets, and the headbands, and the crescents;
The pendants, and the bracelets, and the veils;
The headdresses, and the armlets, and the sashes, and the perfume boxes,
The amulets, and the rings, and the nose jewels;
The festal robes, and the mantles, and the shawls, and the handbags;
The mirrors, and the fine linen, and the turbans, and the capes;

And it shall come to pass that instead of a sweet smell there shall be a stench; and instead of a girdle, a rope; and instead of well-set hair, baldness; and instead of a rich robe, a girding of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.
Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.
"Your foes shall be scattered; they shall flee away; yet you alone shall remain; and you shall be joined with the earth."

sections.title: Chapter 4.

verses.text: And in that day, seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel; only let your name be called upon us; take away our reproach.”

sections.title: Jerusalem shall be renewed as in days of old.

verses.text: And in that day, the Lord shall honor those who have been spared from Israel, and He shall lift them up; for by His counsel, He shall shine upon the earth.
Those who remain in Zion, and those who are left in Jerusalem, all who are written for life in Jerusalem, shall be called holy.
The Lord shall bless the daughters and sons of Zion; for He shall deliver them from the spirit of judgment and from the spirit of burning that is among them.

And the Lord shall come; upon every place that is on the mountain of Zion, and all around it, there shall be a cloud by day like smoke, and by night the brightness of a consuming fire; for over all the glory, there shall be a covering.
It shall be a shelter from the heat, and a refuge and a hiding place from the storm and from the rain.

sections.title: A Psalm concerning the place of wine.

verses.text: አሁን የወይኔን ቦታ በተመለከተ የወዳጄን መዝሙር ለወዳጄ እዘምራለሁ። ለወዳጄ በፍሬያማው ቦታ ላይ የወይን ቦታ ነበረው።
አጥር አጠርሁ፤ በዙሪያውም ቈፈርሁ፤ ድንጋዮችንም ለቅሜ አወጣሁ፤ ምርጥ የሆነውንም ወይን ተከልሁ፤ በመካከሉም ግንብ ሠራሁ፤ ደግሞም የመጥመቂያ ጕድጓድ ማስሁለት፤ ወይንንም ያፈራ ዘንድ ጠበቅሁት፤ ዳሩ ግን እሾህን አፈራ።
አሁንም እናንተ በኢየሩሳሌም የምትኖሩና የይሁዳ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ በእኔና በወይኑ ቦታዬ መካከል እስኪ ፍረዱ።
ለወይኔ ያላደረግሁለት፥ ከዚህ ሌላ አደርግለት ዘንድ የሚገባኝ ምንድን ነው? ወይንን ያፈራል ብዬ ጠበቅሁት፤ ነገር ግን እሾህን አፈራ።
አሁንም በወይኔ ላይ የማደርገውን እነግራችኋለሁ፤ አጥሩን እነቅላለሁ፤ ለብዝበዛም ይሆናል፤ ቅጥሩንም አፈርሳለሁ፤ ለመራገጫም ይሆናል።
ባድማ አደርገዋለሁ፤ አይገረዝም፤ አይኰተኰትም፤ እንደ ጠፍ ቦታ ኵርንችትና እሾህ ይበቅልበታል፤ ዝናብንም እንዳያዘንቡበት ደመናዎችን አዝዛለሁ።
የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ወይን ቦታ እርሱ የእስራኤል ቤት ነው፤ ተወዳጁ አዲስ ተክልም የይሁዳ ሰዎች ናቸው፤ ፍርድን ያደርጋል ብየ እጠብቅ ነበር፤ እነሆም፥ ዐመፅን አደረገ፤ ጽድቅንም አይደለም፥ ጩኸትን እንጂ።
ከጎረቤቶቻቸው እርሻ ይወስዱ ዘንድ፥ ምድርንም ለብቻቸው ይይዟት ዘንድ፥ ቤትን ከቤት ጋር ለሚያያይዙ፥ እርሻንም ከእርሻ ጋር ለሚያቀራርቡ ወዮላቸው!
ይህ በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ጆሮ ተሰምቶአልና፦ ቤቶች ቢሠሩ ባድማ ይሆናሉ፤ ታላላቅና የሚያምሩ ቤቶችም የሚቀመጥባቸው አይኖርም።
ዐሥር ጥማድ በሬ ካረሰው የወይን ቦታ አንድ ፊቀን ወይን ጠጅ ይወጣል፤ ስድስት መስፈሪያ የዘራ ሦስት መሥፈሪያ ብቻ ያገባል።

Woe unto them that go down to Egypt for help, and stay on horses, and trust in chariots; because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!
They drink wine in the feasts and sing songs with the harp, but they regard not the work of the Lord, neither consider the operation of His hands.
Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge; and their honorable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
Hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure; and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled.
But the Lord of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
They that are drawn near to learn shall be as the oxen; and they that are led away shall be as the goats, seeking their food in their hunger.
Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope!
Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
ለክፋት ጥበበኞች ለሆኑ፥ እኛ ጠቢባን ነን ለሚሉም ወዮላቸው!
የወይን ጠጅ ለሚጠጡ ኀያላን፥ የሚያሰክረውንም መጠጥ ለሚደባልቁ ጽኑዓን ወዮላቸው!
በደለኛውን ስለ ጉቦ ጻድቅ ለሚያደርጉ፥ የጻድቁንም ጽድቅ ለሚያስወግዱበት ወዮላቸው!
ስለዚህ ገለባ በእሳት ፍም እንደሚቃጠል፥ በነበልባልም እንደሚበላ፥ እንዲሁ የእነርሱ ሥር የበሰበሰ ይሆናል፤ አበባቸውም እንደ ትቢያ ይበንናል፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ጥለዋልና፤ የእስራኤልም ቅዱስ የተናገረውን ቃል አቃልለዋልና።
ስለዚህ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በሕዝቡ ላይ ታላቅ ቍጣን ተቈጣ፤ እጁንም በላያቸው ዘርግቶ መትቶአቸዋል፤ ተራሮችም ተንቀጠቀጡ፤ ሬሳቸውም በመንገድ መካከል እንደ ጕድፍ ሆኖአል። በዚህም ሁሉ እንኳ ቍጣው አልተመለሰችም፤ ነገር ግን እጁ ገና ተዘርግታ ትኖራለች።
በሩቅ ላሉ አሕዛብም ምልክትን ያቆማል፤ ከምድርም ዳርቻ በፉጨት ይጠራቸዋል፤ እነሆም፥ እየተጣደፉ ፈጥነው ይመጣሉ።
አይራቡም፤ አይጠሙምም፤ አይደክሙም፤ አይተኙም፤ የወገባቸውን መታጠቂያ አይፈቱም፤ የጫማቸውም ማዘቢያ አይበጠስም።
ፍላጾቻቸው ተስለዋል፤ ቀስቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ተለጥጠዋል፤ የፈረሶቻቸውም ኮቴ እንደ ቡላድ፥ የሰረገሎቻቸውም መንኰራኵር እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ይቈጠራል።
ጩኸታቸው እንደ አንበሳ ነው፤ እንደ አንበሳ ደቦሎችም ይቆማሉ፤ ከጕድጓዱ እንደሚወጣ አውሬም ይነጥቃሉ፤ ይጮሃሉ፤ የሚድንም የለም።
በዚያም ቀን እንደ ባሕር መትመም ይተምሙባቸዋል፤ ወደ ምድርም ይመለከታሉ፤ ድቅድቅ ጨለማን ያያሉ፤ ይጨነቃሉም።

sections.title: The calling of Isaiah to the prophetic ministry.

verses.text: ከዚህም በኋላ ንጉሡ ዖዝያን በሞተበት ዓመት እግዚአብሔርን በረዥምና ከፍ ባለ ዙፋን ላይ ተቀምጦ አየሁት፤ ምስጋናውም ቤቱን ሞልቶት ነበር።
ሱራፌልም በዙሪያው ቆመው ነበር፤ ለእያንዳንዱም ስድስት ክንፍ ነበረው፤ በሁለቱ ክንፎቻቸው ፊታቸውን ይሸፍኑ ነበር፤ በሁለቱም ክንፎቻቸው እግሮቻቸውን ይሸፍኑ ነበር፤ በሁለቱም ክንፎቻቸው ይበርሩ ነበር።
አንዱም ለአንዱ፥ “ቅዱስ፥ ቅዱስ፥ ቅዱስ፥ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ምድር ሁሉ ከክብሩ ተሞልታለች” እያለ ይጮኽ ነበር።
የመድረኩም መሠረት ከጩኸታቸው ድምፅ የተነሣ ተናወጠ፤ ቤቱንም ጢስ ሞላበት።
እኔም፥ “ከንፈሮች የረከሱብኝ ሰው በመሆኔ፥ ከንፈሮቻቸው በረከሱባቸው ሕዝብ መካከል በመቀመጤ ዐይኖች የሠራዊትን ጌታ ንጉሡን እግዚአብሔርን ስለ አዩ ጠፍቻለሁና ወዮልኝ!” አልሁ።
ከሱራፌል አንዱ ወደ እኔ ተላከ፤ በእጁም ከመሠዊያው በጕጠት የወሰደው ፍም ነበረ።
አፌንም ዳሰሰበትና፥ “እነሆ፥ ይህ ከንፈሮችህን ነክቶአል፤ በደልህም ከአንተ ተወገደ፤ ኀጢአትህም ተሰረየልህ” አለኝ።
የጌታንም ድምፅ፥ “ማንን እልካለሁ? ማንስ ወደዚያ ሕዝብ ይሄድልናል?” ሲል ሰማሁ? እኔም፥ “እነሆኝ፥ ጌታዬ፥ እኔን ላከኝ” አልሁ።
እርሱም፥ “ሂድ፤ ይህን ሕዝብ፦ መስማትን ትሰማላችሁ፥ አታስተውሉምም፤ ማየትንም ታያላችሁ፥ አትመለከቱምም” በላቸው አለኝ።
እነዚህ ሕዝቦች በዐይናቸው እንዳያዩ፥ በጆሮአቸውም እንዳይሰሙ፥ በልባቸውም እንዳያስተውሉ ተመልሰውም እንዳልፈውሳቸው፥ ልባቸውን አደንድነዋልና፥ ጆሮአቸውንም ደፍነዋልና፥ ዐይኖቻቸውንም ጨፍነዋልና።
እኔም፥ “ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ነው?” አልሁ። እርሱም መልሶ እንዲህ አለኝ፥ “ከተሞች የሚኖርባቸውን አጥተው እስኪፈርሱ ድረስ፥ ቤቶችም ሰው አልቦ እስኪሆኑ፥ ምድርም ፈጽሞ ባድማ ሆና እስክትቀር ድረስ ነው፤”
ከዚያም በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ሰዎችን ያርቃል፤ በምድርም የቀሩት ይበዛሉ።
በእርስዋም ዘንድ ዐሥረኛ እጅ ቀርቶ እንደ ሆነ እርሱ ደግሞ ይቃጠላል፤ ቅጠሎቻቸውም በረገፉ ጊዜ እንደ ግራርና እንደ ኮምበል ዛፍ ሁነው ይቀራሉ።

sections.title: The message that came to King Ahaz.

verses.text: And it came to pass; in the days of Ahaz, son of Jotham, son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin, king of Aram, and Pekah, son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to wage war against it, but could not prevail against it.
And it was told to the house of David, saying, “Aram has allied itself with Ephraim,” and his heart and the heart of his people shook as the trees of the forest shake before the wind.
And the Lord said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you and your son Shear-jashub, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway to the washer's field.

And say to him, ‘Take heed, and be quiet; do not fear, and do not let your heart be faint because of these two smoldering stumps of firebrands, at the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and the son of Remaliah.
Because Aram, the son of Remaliah, has plotted evil against you, saying,
“Let us go up against Judah and terrify it, and let us conquer it for ourselves, and set up the son of Tabeel as king in the midst of it.”
Thus says the Lord God: “It shall not stand, and it shall not come to pass.”
The head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; within sixty-five years, Ephraim will be shattered from being a people.
And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is the son of Remaliah. If you are not firm in faith, you will not be firm at all.”

sections.title: The Prophecy of the Birth of Emmanuel

verses.text: And the Lord spoke to Ahaz, saying,
“If you are asked for a sign, whether from the deep or from the heights, why would you seek a sign from your God, the Lord?”
And Ahaz said, “I will not ask, nor will I test the Lord.”
And he said, “Hear now, O house of David; is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will you weary my God also?
Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign; behold, the virgin shall conceive and bear a Son, and shall call His name Immanuel.
The child shall eat curds and honey, before he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
The child shall eat curds and honey, before he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good; and the land of the two kings whom you dread will be deserted.
The Lord will bring upon you and upon your people and upon your father's house such days as have not come since the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, the king of Assyria will come.
And in that day, the Lord will whistle for the fly that is at the end of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
They will all come and settle in the steep ravines, in the clefts of the rocks, and on all the thorn bushes, and at all the pastures.

And in that day, the Lord shall bring forth a great flood from the depths of the river; He shall sweep away the crown of the Assyrian king and his glorious diadem; and the flood shall also sweep away the pride of the mighty.
And in that day, it shall come to pass that a man shall raise one girdle from among the poor and two goats; and the one goat shall bear the burden of two men.
And the burden shall increase; and all that remains in the land shall be consumed with fat and honey.

In those days, it shall be thus; and wine shall be abundant in the land; the price of one thousand measures of wine shall be as one thousand pieces of silver. After this, the earth shall be utterly destroyed; it shall be filled with ashes and filth; and terror shall come upon the land.
In desolation and in destruction shall they enter; for the whole land shall be consumed, and it shall be filled with ashes and filth.
And upon every mountain that is laid waste, terror shall come; it shall be a refuge for the goats; and the cattle shall be scattered; and ashes and filth shall cover it.

sections.title: The son of Isaiah shall be as a sign unto the people.

verses.text: And the Lord said unto me, “A great new tablet shall be given unto thee: ‘Thou art marked; hasten and be swift’ as thou writest upon the face of man’s glory.
Bear witness for me concerning the faithful, the priest Uriyah and the son of Berechiah, Zechariah; for the Spirit of the Lord hath come upon them.”
And I drew near unto the prophet; and she conceived; and a son was born unto her. And the Lord said unto me, “Call his name ‘Thou art marked; hasten and be swift.’”
The child shall call upon his father and mother, not knowing that the wealth of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken before the king of Assyria.”
And the Lord also spoke unto me, saying:
“Behold, my people are led away by the rod; in the waters of Siloah that go softly, they are counselled; for they shall be beloved, that they may be delivered from the son of Romel.”

Therefore, behold, the Lord shall bring upon them the mighty and abundant waters, even the king of Assyria and all his glory; and the river shall overflow and shall go forth; and it shall cover all their paths;
He shall sweep away every man from Judah; he shall also destroy the mighty; and their dwelling shall be filled in the wide land and in all their countries; for the Lord is with us.
O nations, take heed and be troubled; even unto the ends of the earth hear; O mighty ones! Be strong; if ye are strengthened again, ye shall surely prevail.
If ye take counsel, the Lord shall frustrate your counsel; and that which ye have spoken shall not come to pass. For the Lord is with us.
የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በጽኑ እጅ እንዲህ ተናገረኝ፤ በዚህም ሕዝብ መንገድ እንዳልሄድ አስጠነቀቀኝ፤
እንዲህም አለኝ፥ “ይህ ሕዝብ፦ ከባድ ነው የሚለውን ሁሉ፦ ከባድ ነው አትበሉ፤ መፈራታቸውንም አትፍሩ፤ አትደንግጡም።
ነገር ግን የሠራዊትን ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን ቀድሱት፤ የሚያስፈራችሁና የሚያስደነግጣችሁም እርሱ ይሁን።
ብታምንበት ይቀድስሃል፤ እንደ ድንጋይ ዕንቅፋትም አያደናቅፍህም፤ እንደሚያድጥ ዓለትም አይሆንብህም፤ ሁለቱ የያዕቆብ ቤቶች ግን በኢየሩሳሌም በወጥመድና በአሽክላ ተይዘው ይኖራሉ።
ስለዚህም ከእነርሱ ብዙዎች በእርሱ ይሰናከላሉ፤ ይወድቁማል፤ ይሰበሩማል፤ ይጠመዱማል፤ ይያዙማል።”
እንዳይማሩአት ሕግን የሚያጠፉአት ሰዎች ያንጊዜ ይገለጣሉ።
ከያዕቆብም ቤት ፊቱን የመለሰውን እግዚአብሔርን እጠብቃለሁ፥ እተማመንበትማለሁ።
እነሆ፥ እኔና እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝ ልጆች ለእስራኤል በጽዮን ተራራ ከሚኖረው ከሠራዊት ጌታ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ምልክትና ተአምራት ነን።
እነርሱም፥ “ድምፃቸውን ዝቅ አድርገው የሚናገሩትን መናፍስት ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችን ጠይቁ” ባሉአችሁ ጊዜ፥ ሕዝቡ ከአምላኩ መጠየቅ አይገባውምን? ወይስ ለሕያዋን ሲሉ ሙታንን ይጠይቃሉን?
ነገሩ እንዲህ አይደለም ይሉ ዘንድ፥ ለእርሱም ግብር እንዳይሰጡ ሕግን ለርዳታ ሰጥቶአልና።
Truly, affliction shall come upon you; in your time of trouble, you shall be distressed; you shall speak evil against rulers and the mighty; and you shall look up to the heights and to the heavens.

And you shall look down to the earth; you shall see the deep darkness; you shall receive great anguish; you shall be distressed; you shall suffer; and before you shall be darkness; you shall not see; and in the time of trouble, it shall not be removed until it comes.

sections.title: Concerning the coming King.

verses.text: Until the time of this arrival, all who have been troubled shall not find rest; in the former age, He has made desolate the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter age, He shall honor the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, the Galilee of the Gentiles.
The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light; those who dwelt in the land of the shadow of death, upon them a light has shined.
Thou hast brought forth many people with joy; as they rejoice in harvest, so shall they rejoice before Thee.
In the time of the wilderness, as it was, the glory that was upon them has arisen; and the burden that was upon them, the sorrowful, has been lifted.
A garment stained with blood shall not suffice for anything, except when it is consumed by fire.
For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given; and the government shall be upon His shoulder; and His name shall be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

To the rulers, I shall bring peace, and to him, I shall bring life; from this day forth, even unto eternity, He shall be established in judgment and righteousness; His dominion shall be great; the kingdom shall be established upon the throne of David; and for peace, there shall be no end. The Lord of hosts shall perform this.
The Lord sent death upon Jacob; and it fell upon Israel.
The people of Ephraim and all who dwell in Samaria shall know; in pride and arrogance of heart, they shall say:
"Let us break their bonds; however, let us come, let us build a wall; for the wicked have been broken; however, let us establish righteousness; and for ourselves, let us build a tower."
Therefore, the Lord shall be angry with those who rise against Him upon the mountain of Zion.

He shall sweep away the adversaries, the Syrians from the east, and the Arabs from the west; and Israel shall be devoured by a mouth that is opened wide. Yet in all this, His anger has not turned back; nevertheless, His hand is still stretched out.
But the people have not returned until they are crushed; they have not sought the Lord, the God of hosts.
Therefore, the Lord shall cut off from Israel head and tail, great and small, in one day.
The ruler and the one who leads before him, he is the head; and the prophet who teaches falsehood, he is the tail.
Those who give thanks for this people shall be made to stumble; they shall be devoured for the sake of their stumbling.

For every man is wicked and a deceiver; and every mouth speaks folly; therefore the Lord shall not rejoice in their young men, nor shall He have compassion on their orphans and widows. In all this, His anger has not turned back; nevertheless, His hand is still stretched out.
Sin shall be like a fire; it shall consume like the dry stubble; it shall consume like the thorns; all that is around the mountains shall be consumed together.
By the wrath of the Lord, the whole earth shall be consumed; and the people shall be as wood that is consumed by fire; and man shall not spare his brother.
Yet man shall return to the right; he shall be filled with pride; and to the left he shall devour; he shall not be satisfied.

Each one shall eat the flesh of his own arm; Manasseh shall devour Ephraim, and Ephraim shall devour Manasseh; they shall be as one in their enmity against Judah. Yet for all this, His anger is not turned away, but His hand is still stretched out.
Woe unto them that write iniquity!

Let the oppressors be as they are, that they may increase the number of the children of the dead, that they may pervert the judgment of the poor, and that they may rob the needy of their rights; woe unto them that issue decrees of violence!
On the day of your calamity, what will you do? For trouble shall come from afar, and to whom will you flee for help?
Do not be crushed in despair; where will you cast away your glory? Yet, even in all this, His anger has not turned back; nevertheless, His hand is still stretched out.
Woe unto those who are for my anger, and who bear the burden of my wrath in their hands!
I will send my wrath upon a sinful people; let them be consumed and let them perish, and let their cities be laid waste, for I have cried out against my people.
He does not think in his heart like this; neither does he consider it thus; yet in his heart there is a desire to destroy, to cut off a few of the nations.
If they say, "Are you the only leader?" he will reply, "I have taken the dwelling of Hemath."
As Hemath is, so is Arpad; as Arpad is, so are Sepharvaim; as Sepharvaim is, so is Kalneh; as Kalneh is, so is Damascos; is Samaria not like Damascos?
Thus will I do to Judah; is there not an idol in Jerusalem and in Samaria that we may worship?
As I have done in Samaria and in her idols, so will I do in Jerusalem and in her idols.
Therefore it shall be thus; the Lord shall perform all His work upon Mount Zion and upon Jerusalem; He shall cut off the heart of the king of Assyria, and the height of his eyes shall be humbled.
He has said, "I will act with my strength; with wisdom I will protect the borders of the nations; I will consume their wealth."

I will also bring forth the cities wherein they dwell. With my hand I will gather all the world as a bird gathers her brood; as a hen gathers her chicks, so will I take them; and there is none who can deliver from my hand; there is none who can oppose me.

"Will it rise upon a man who is in a true place? Or will it be a burden upon a man who is in distress? This is as if it were to rise upon those who are to be slain; it is as if I were to say, 'I am not like a tree.'"
Therefore the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, shall bring down the pride upon your glory, and upon your beauty shall He send forth a fire that shall consume.
The glory of Israel shall be as a fire; and the fire that rises shall be holy; and the tree shall be as a stubble.
At that time the mountains and the hills, and the trees shall be consumed. The soul and the flesh shall be devoured; and he who flees shall be as the fire that rises.
And the remnant of the trees of the forest shall be few in number; and the small ones shall be consumed.

sections.title: The Chronicles of Israel

verses.text: And it shall come to pass at that time; the cry of Israel shall not be heard from the house of Jacob any longer; but in truth, they shall cry out to the Holy One of Israel to the Lord their God.
The cry of Jacob shall prevail before the mighty God.
And though the number of the people of Israel be as the sand of the sea, only a remnant shall be saved.
For the Lord of hosts, the Lord God, shall execute judgment upon all that is broken in the world in truth.

Therefore, the Lord of hosts, the Lord God, shall say, “O My people who dwell in Zion, fear not the Assyrian; for he shall strike you with a rod, and I will bring forth your deliverance from the way of Egypt.”
For a little while, My anger shall be turned away; but with everlasting mercy, I shall deal with you.”
And the Lord shall lift up the land in its affliction as a mighty giant; and His anger shall be upon the way of the sea and upon the way of Egypt.
In that day, the light shall be lifted from your darkness, and your fear shall descend upon you; and the light shall be lifted from your darkness and shall be extinguished.
And it shall come to the city of Angai; it shall not pass by Megiddo; it shall carry its burden within the confines of Makmas.
It shall not pass by Kola; and when it reaches Angai, they shall fear the remnant and the city of Saul.
The daughter of Galim shall tremble; she shall hear upon the heights; and the daughters shall hear it.
Those who dwell in the stronghold shall rejoice.
Today, let them dwell in His hand; on their way, let them seek; let the daughter of Zion strengthen the mountains and the borders of Jerusalem.
Behold, the Lord of hosts, the Lord God, shall strike down the mighty with strength; and the great shall be brought low; the lofty shall be humbled.
The great ones shall fall by the sword; and Lebanon shall fall with its majestic trees.

sections.title: Peace be upon the kingdom wherein it dwelleth.

verses.text: She shall come forth from the root of Jesse; and a flower shall blossom from his branch.
The Spirit of the Lord, the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and might, the Spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord shall rest upon him.
The spirit that causes fear of the Lord shall fill him; he shall not judge by the sight of his eyes, nor decide by the hearing of his ears;

But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and decide with equity for the meek of the earth; and he shall strike the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
And he shall be girded with righteousness upon his loins, and truth shall be the belt about his waist.
The wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
The cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together; and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
And the nursing child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.
They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.

sections.title: The Return of Israel from Exile

verses.text: In that day, the root of Jesse shall stand as a banner for the people; the nations shall seek him, and his resting place shall be glorious.

In that day, it shall be said: From Assyria and from Egypt, from Babylon and from Ethiopia, from Elam and from the east and from the west, the remnant of the people shall return; the Lord shall once again extend His hand to recover them.

And for the remnant of Israel, a sign shall be established; and the remnants of Israel shall be gathered; from Judah, those who are scattered shall be brought together from the four corners of the earth.
The envy of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off; Ephraim shall not be envious of Judah, and Judah shall not trouble Ephraim.

On the sea, they shall descend upon the ships of the Philistines; they shall plunder the east and Edom together; they shall stretch out their hands against Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
The Lord shall dry up the sea of Egypt; with a mighty wind, He shall wave His hand over the river, and He shall smite it into seven streams, so that men may walk over dry-shod.
As it was when Israel went out of Egypt, so shall it be in that day, when there shall be a highway for the remnant of His people who shall be left from Assyria.

sections.title: Psalm of Praise

verses.text: On that day, you shall say, “O Lord, for You have been angry with me; Your wrath has turned away, and You have comforted me. I will give thanks to You.”
Behold, my God is my salvation; the Lord God is my strength and my song; He also has become my salvation; I trust in Him; I shall not be afraid.
And you shall draw water from the wells of salvation with joy.
On that day, you shall say, “Give thanks to the Lord; call upon His name; make known His deeds among the peoples; proclaim that His name is exalted.”
For He has done glorious things; sing praises to the name of the Lord; let this be made known in all the earth.
O daughter of Zion, rejoice greatly; O daughter of Jerusalem, shout aloud; for the Holy One of Israel is exalted in your midst.”

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Babylon, which Isaiah son of Amoz saw.

verses.text: The vision which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Babylon.
Set up a sign upon the barren mountain; lift up your voice unto them; shake the rulers with your hand; open the gates.
I will bring forth my holy ones; I will bring forth my mighty ones; they shall come rejoicing; they shall execute my wrath; they have been summoned.

Upon the mountains there is a voice as of a great multitude; the voice of the gathered kings and the voice of the nations is heard. The Lord of hosts, the mighty one, has commanded the nations to come forth.
The Lord God and the army of His wrath shall come from a far country, from the end of heaven.
For the day of the Lord is near; do not let it pass; destruction shall come from the Lord.
Therefore every hand shall be faint; every man shall be troubled;
The pregnant women shall be in anguish; as a woman in labor, they shall be in pain; they shall look to one another; they shall be astonished; their faces shall be as flames.
Behold, the day of the Lord shall come to make the earth desolate, and to destroy its sinners from it; filled with fierce and unyielding wrath, the day of the Lord shall come.
The stars of heaven and their constellations shall not give their light; the hosts of heaven shall not shine; the sun shall be darkened in its going forth; and the moon shall not give her light.
በዓለም ሁሉ ላይ ክፋትን አዝዛለሁ፤ የኀጢአተኞችንም ኀጢአት እጐበኛለሁ፤ የትዕቢተኞችንም ኵራት እሽራለሁ፤ የጨካኞቹንም ኵራት አዋርዳለሁ።
የተረፉትም ከጥሩ ወርቅ ይልቅ የከበሩ ይሆናሉ፤ ሰውም ከሰንፔር ዕንቍ ይልቅ የከበረ ይሆናል።
ስለዚህ በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር መዓት በጽኑ ቍጣው ቀንም ሰማያት ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፤ ምድርም ከመሠረቷ ትናወጣለች።
የተረፉትም ሁሉ እንደ ተባረረ ሚዳቋ፥ እንደ ባዘነ በግም ይሆናሉ። የሚሰበስባቸውም የለም፤ እንዲሁም ሰው ሁሉ ወደ ወገኑ ይመለሳል፤ ሁሉም ሰው ወደ ሀገሩ ይሸሻል።
የተበተኑት ሁሉ ይሞታሉ፤ የተሰበሰቡትም ሁሉ በጦር ይወድቃሉ።
ሕፃኖቻቸውንም በፊታቸው ይጨፈጭፋሉ፤ ቤቶቻቸውንም ይበዘብዛሉ፤ ሚስቶቻቸውንም ያስነውራሉ።
እነሆ፥ ብር የማይሹትን፥ ወርቅም የማያምራቸውን ሜዶናውያንን በእናንተ ላይ አስነሣለሁ።
ፍላጾቻቸውም ጐበዞችን ይጨፈጭፋሉ፤ ሕፃኖቻችሁንም አይምሩም፤ ዐይኖቻቸውም ለልጆቻችሁ አይራሩም።
የመንግሥታት ክብር፥ የከለዳውያንም የትዕቢታቸው ትምክሕት የሆነች ባቢሎንም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ገለበጣቸው እንደ ሰዶምና እንደ ገሞራ ትሆናለች።
ለዘለዓለም የሚቀመጥባት አይገኝም፤ ከትውልድም እስከ ትውልድ ድረስ ሰው አይኖርባትም፤ ዓረባውያንም በእርሷ አያልፉም፤ እረኞችም በውስጥዋ አያርፉም።
And there shall the beasts of the wilderness lie down; the houses shall be full of owls; there shall the ostriches dwell; and there shall the satyrs dance.
The wild goats shall call to one another there; the hedgehogs shall dwell in their habitations; this shall be swift, it shall not be delayed.

sections.title: Concerning the return of the people of Israel from exile.

verses.text: And the Lord shall choose Jacob for Himself, and Israel for His peculiar treasure; and in their land shall they be gathered, and the scribes shall be one with them; they shall be joined with the house of Jacob.

The nations shall bring them to their place; and the children of Israel shall inherit them; and in that land shall they multiply; and there shall be men servants and maid servants. Their oppressors shall be for them as a possession; and they shall possess their possessors.
And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall deliver thee from thy sorrow and from thy trouble, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve.
This also shall be a burden upon the king of Babylon; thus shall you say, "How hath the oppressor ceased! The golden city ceased!"
The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the scepter of the rulers.
The Lord hath cut off the nations in His wrath; He hath pursued them, and hath not spared them.
The whole earth is at rest and is quiet; they break forth into singing.
The cedars of Lebanon: From the time thou wast laid low, no one hath come to make us afraid; they rejoice at thee.

"Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming; it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations."
All these shall speak and say unto thee, "Art thou also become weak as we? Art thou become like unto us?"
"From your glory you have fallen to Sheol; even beneath you the foundation is broken; you have become as one who is cast down." Thus they shall answer you.
"O morning star, how you have fallen from heaven! You who did send a message to the nations, how you are cut down to the ground!"
"You also in your heart have said: 'I will ascend to heaven; above the stars of God will I exalt my throne; I will sit upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north.'"
"I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the Most High."
"Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the sides of the pit."
"Those who see you shall stare at you; they shall ponder over you, saying: 'Is this the man who made the earth tremble, who shook kingdoms?'"
"He who made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed its cities, who did not open the house of his prisoners?"
"All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, each in his own tomb."

"But you are cast out of your grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit, as a carcass trodden under feet."
"You shall not be joined with them in burial, because you have destroyed your land, and slain your people; the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned."

"Let them not be moved, nor let the earth be shaken, nor let the face of the world be filled with war; for the sake of their fathers, let them be destroyed in sin, that your children may be prepared."
"I will set my face against them," says the Lord of hosts, "and I will cut off their name and their remnant, and their offspring and their posterity." says the Lord.
"I will make Babylon a dwelling place for owls; it shall be desolate like the abode of the wild beasts; and I will make it a heap of ruins," says the Lord of hosts.

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Assyria.

verses.text: The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, hath spoken thus: "As I have said, so shall it surely come to pass; as I have purposed, so shall it stand."
I will break Assyria upon my land; and upon my mountains will I tread him down; and his yoke shall depart from off them, and his burden shall be taken away from off their shoulders.
This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth; and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
The Holy One, God, hath given this counsel; who shall declare the counsel of the Lord? And who shall turn back his stretched-out hand?

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Philistia.

verses.text: In the year that King Ahaz died, this came to pass.
O Philistia, from the root of the serpent shall come forth a viper, and its fruit shall be like a fiery serpent; for your strength has been crushed, and all of you shall not rejoice.
And the poor shall be heard within you; the poor shall dwell in peace; your seed shall be consumed; and those who remain among you shall not be few.

O you gates of the cities, woe unto you; you cities, take heed, cry out; O inhabitants of Philistia, all of you are laid waste; for the pestilence shall come forth from the north, and henceforth you shall not dwell.
What shall the kings of the nations answer? The Lord has founded Zion; He will gather the people who are pure of heart.

sections.title: Concerning the Destruction of Moab

verses.text: Concerning Moab, thus saith the word: Moab shall be destroyed in the night; her people shall perish in the night.

For your own sake, wail; for your gods and your altars in Dibon shall be destroyed; and there also shall you go, and you shall not be able to escape from Moab; and woe unto you! Every head shall be made bald, and every shoulder shall be peeled.
In every street, they shall wail; in every square, they shall say, "Woe!" as they pour forth their tears abundantly.
Heshbon and Elealeh shall cry out; their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz; therefore shall the arm of Moab be shattered.

Moab shall cry out for her own sake; her heart shall mourn for her; even unto Segor shall she flee alone. Moab is like a three-year-old heifer, and she shall cry out in her distress. They shall return by the way of Arnon; they shall cry out, and destruction and lamentation shall be their fate.
For my waters shall be poured out; her cities shall be laid waste; within her, there shall be no inhabitants.
Therefore, shall Moab be left desolate? I shall bring the Arabians unto her, and they shall possess her.
The cry of Moab shall be heard throughout all her borders; her lamentation shall reach to Eglaim and to Elim.

The waters of Dimon shall be filled with blood; for I shall bring the Arabians upon Dimon; and I shall slay the Moabites and the Ammonites, and those that remain of Edom shall be cast down as a beast upon the earth.
የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ተራራ ምድረ በዳ አይደለችምን?
ጫጩቶችዋን አሳድጋ እንደ ተወች ወፍ ሆናለችና፤ የሞዓብ ሴት ልጅም እንደ ሰባ የበግ ጠቦት ሆነች።
አርኖንም በምትኖርበት ምሽግ መጠለያን ትሠራ ዘንድ ብዙ ትመክራለች፤ በቀትር ጊዜ እንደ ሌሊት ደንግጠው ይሸሻሉ፤ ወደ እናንተም አታስገቡአቸው።
ከሚከቧችሁ ጋር ጠላቶች እንዳይሆኗችሁ ከሞዓብ የተሰደዱትን ከእናንተ ጋር አታስቀምጡ፤ ሰልፈኞች አልቀዋልና፤ በሀገሪቱ ሁሉ የነበረውም አለቃ ጠፍቶአልና።
ዙፋን በምሕረት ይጸናል፥ በዚያም ላይ በዳዊት ቤት ፍርድን የሚሻ ጽድቅንም የሚያፋጥን ፈራጅ በእውነት ይቀመጣል፤ ይፈርዳልም።
የሞዓብን ትዕቢትና እጅግ መኵራቱን ሰምተናል፤ ትዕቢቱንም አስወገድሁ፤ ጥንቈላህ እንዲህ አይደለምና፥ እንዲህም አይደለም፤
ሞዓብ ዋይ በሉ፤ ሁሉም በሞዓብ ዋይ ይላሉና፤ በዴሴት የሚኖሩም አያመልጡም፤ ጠብን ያጭራሉ፤ ያፍራሉም።
የሐሴቦን እርሻዎችና የሴባማ ወይን ግንዶች አዝነዋል። የአሕዛብ አለቆች የሰባበሩአቸው ቅርንጫፎች እስከ ኢያዜር ደርሰው ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወጥተው ነበር፤ ቍጥቋጦቹም ተዘርግተው ባሕርን ተሻግረው ነበር።
ስለዚህ በኢያዜር ልቅሶ ስለ ሴባማ ወይን ግንድ አለቅሳለሁ፤ ሐሴቦንና ኤልያሊ ሆይ፥ ዛፎችሽ ወድቀዋል፤ የዛፍሽን ፍሬና የወይንሽን መከር እረግጣለሁ፤ ተክሎችሽ ሁሉ ይወድቃሉ።
ደስታና ሐሤትም ከወይን ቦታሽ ተወስዶአል፤ በወይንሽም ቦታዎች ፈጽመው ደስ አይላቸውም፤ በመጥመቂያውም ወይንን አይረግጡም፤ ረጋጮቹን አጥፍቻለሁና።
Therefore, my heart cries out concerning Moab, like a harp; and its limbs shall be as a broken wall.
Let it be for desolation; for Moab is stricken in her sanctuaries; and to her idols she goes to pray; yet they cannot help her.
The word that the Lord spoke concerning Moab in ancient times is this.

And now I say this: Within three years, as a hired man would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought low, along with her great abundance; and the number shall be very few; her glory shall not be found.

sections.title: Syria and Israel shall be as they are.

verses.text: Concerning Damascus, the word that was spoken: "Behold, Damascus shall cease from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap."
It shall be a desolation forever; it shall be a place for the flocks to lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

Ephraim shall be like a bird that has no nest; from now on, a king shall not reign in Damascus. O city of Syria, you shall not be better than the children of Israel in their glory," says the Lord of hosts.
"In that day it shall come to pass that the glory of Jacob shall wane, and the fatness of his flesh shall grow lean."
As the reaper gathers the standing grain, and he that harvests the ears of corn shall gather them, so shall it be.
"When the grape is beaten, two or three berries shall remain on the top of the bough; four or five in the fruitful branches," says the God of Israel.
In that day, a man shall trust in his Maker, and his eyes shall look to the Holy One of Israel.
They shall not trust in their altars, nor say to the work of their hands, 'You are our gods'; for in the day of their calamity, they shall not be able to save them.

In that day, before the children of Israel, the cities of the Amorites and the cities of the Hivites shall be as if they were broken; likewise, your cities shall be broken, and they shall be desolate.
Your destroyer has forsaken the Lord, and your helper has not remembered the Lord; therefore, you have sown the seeds of falsehood, and you have reaped the harvest of lies.
ተክልን በተከልህበት ቀን ትበድላለህ፤ የዘራኸውም በበነጋው በምታወርስበት ቀን ይበቅላል፤ አባትም ለልጁ እንደሚያወርስ አንተም ለልጆችህ ታወርሳለህ።
እንደ ውኃ ለሞሉ፥ ከተራራ በመከታተል እንደሚወርድ የውኃ ፈሳሽ ለሆኑም ብዙዎች አሕዛብ ወዮላቸው!
ብዙዎች አሕዛብ እንደ ብዙ ውኃ ናቸው፤ ከፏፏቴ ውስጥ በኀይል እንደሚወርድ እንደ ብዙ ውኃ ፈሳሽ ይጮኻሉ፤ ያጠፉታልም፤ እነርሱም ከሩቅ ይወርዳሉ፤ በተራራም ላይ እንዳለ እብቅ፥ በነፋስ ፊት ዐውሎ ነፋስ እንደሚያዞረው እንደ መንኰራኵር ትቢያም ይበተናሉ።
በመሸም ጊዜ ሳይነጋ ያለቅሳሉ፤ ያንጊዜም የይሁዳ ወገኖች “ይህ የወራሾች ርስት ነው፤ የበዘበዙንም ዕድል ፋንታ ይህ ነው” ይላሉ።

sections.title: Concerning Ethiopia, it has been spoken.

verses.text: በኢትዮጵያ ወንዞች ማዶ ላለች፥ ክንፍ ያላቸው መርከቦች ላሉባት ምድር ወዮላት!
መልእክተኞችን በባሕር ላይ፥ ደብዳቤዎችንም በውኃ ላይ ይልካል። ፈጣኖች መልእክተኞች ወደ ረዥምና ወደ ባዕድ፥ ወደ ክፉም ሕዝብ ይሄዳሉና፤ ተስፋ የቈረጡና የተረገጡ ሕዝብ እነማን ናቸው? ዛሬ ግን የምድር ወንዞች ሁሉ፥ ሰዎች እንደሚኖሩባት ሀገር ይኖራሉ።
በየሀገራቸው ይቀመጣሉ፤ ከተራሮች ራሶችም እንደ ዓላማ ይይዙታል፤ እንደ መለከት ድምፅም ይሰማል።
እግዚአብሔር፥ “እንደ ቀትር ብርሃን፥ በአጨዳም ወራት እንደ ጠል ደመና በማደሪያዬ ጸጥታ ይሆናል” ብሎኛልና።
እርሱ ከመከር በፊት አበባ በረገፈ ጊዜ የወይንም ፍሬ ጨርቋ ሲይዝ የወይኑን ቀጫጭን ዘንግ በማጭድ ይቈርጣል፤ ጫፎቹንም ይመለምላል፤ ያስወግድማል።
ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አውሬዎችም በአንድነት ይቀራሉ፤ የሰማይ ወፎችና የምድር አውሬዎችም ሁሉ ይሰበሰቡባቸዋል።
በዚያ ዘመን ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር፥ ከተዋረደና ከደከመ ሕዝብ፥ ከዛሬ እስከ ዘለዓለም ታላቅ ከሆነ ወገን፥ ተስፋ ከሚያደርግና ከሚረገጥ፥ በሀገሩ ወንዝ ዳር ከሚኖር ሕዝብ ዘንድ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ስም በተጠራበት በደብረ ጽዮን እጅ መንሻ ይቀርባል።

sections.title: The Prophecy Concerning Egypt

verses.text: Concerning the vision that was spoken of Egypt. Behold, the Lord shall come swiftly in a cloud to Egypt; and the idols of Egypt shall tremble at His presence, and the heart of the Egyptians shall melt within them.
"The Egyptians shall rise against the Egyptians; brother shall fight against brother, and man against his neighbor; city shall rise against city, and kingdom against kingdom."
The spirit of Egypt shall be troubled within them; I will destroy their counsel; and they shall seek to the idols and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits and to the wizards.
"And I will deliver the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them," saith the Lord, the God of hosts.
The Egyptians shall drink the water of the sea; and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
And the rivers shall stink; the brooks of Egypt shall be diminished and dried up; the reeds and flags shall wither.
In the river and the streams shall be desolate, and all the sown fields by the river shall be dried up; they shall wither and be no more.
The fishers shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament; and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
They that work in fine flax and they that weave networks shall be confounded.
And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof; all that make sluices and ponds for fish shall be ashamed; their hearts shall melt.

The lords of Tanis shall be as a snare; and the wise men who counsel kings shall be in confusion. To the king, they shall say, “We are the children of the wise men, and the children of the former kings; how then shall you speak to us?”
Now where are your wise men? Now let them be silent; until the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, brings upon you that which He has decreed against Egypt.
The lords of Tanis are in authority; and the lords of Memphis are exalted; the Egyptians have stumbled in every tribe.
For the Lord God has sent a spirit of confusion upon them; and they have erred, even the Egyptians, in all their works.
For the Egyptians have no head or tail, no beginning or end in their labor.
In that day, the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, shall cause the Egyptians to be like women, trembling and fearful at the sight of the terror that He brings upon them.
The land of Judah shall be a terror to Egypt; for the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, shall raise a sound that shall be heard by all who hear it, and they shall be afraid.

In that day, five cities in the land of Egypt shall speak the language of Canaan; and they shall call upon the name of the Lord of hosts, and one of those cities shall be called the City of Righteousness.
In that day, one city in the land of Egypt shall be a house of worship for the Lord; and at its gate shall be an altar for the Lord.

This shall be a sign for the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt, for it shall be a witness unto the world; and they shall cry unto the Lord because of their oppressors, and He shall send them a Savior, and He shall deliver them.
በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር በግብፅ የታወቀ ይሆናል፤ በዚያም ጊዜ ግብፃውያን እግዚአብሔርን ያውቃሉ፤ መሥዋዕትም ያቀርቡለታል፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ስእለት ይሳላሉ፤ መባኡንም ያገባሉ።
እግዚአብሔርም ግብፅን በታላቅ መቅሠፍት ይመታታል፤ ይፈውሳታልም፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይመለሳሉ፤ እርሱም ይሰማቸዋል፤ ይፈውሳቸውማል።
በዚያም ወራት ከግብፅ ወደ አሦር መንገድ ይሆናል፤ አሦራዊውም ወደ ግብፅ፥ ግብፃዊውም ወደ አሦር ይገባል፤ ግብፃውያንም ለአሦራውያን ይገዛሉ።
በዚያም ወራት እስራኤል ለግብፅና ለአሦር ሦስተኛ ይሆናል፤ በምድርም መካከል በረከት ይሆናል።
የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ “በግብፅ ውስጥ ያለ ሕዝቤ፥ በአሦር መካከልም ያለ ሕዝቤ፥ ርስቴም እስራኤል የተባረከ ይሁን” ብሎ ይባርካቸዋልና።

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Ethiopia and Egypt.

verses.text: In the time when the king of Assyria sent forth, and he came unto Azalon, and when he approached Azalon,
In that year, the Lord spoke unto Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, remove your sackcloth from off your loins; and take your shoes off your feet.” And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.

And the Lord said, “As my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia, so shall the king of Assyria lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.”

Thus shall the king of Assyria lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, and they shall be ashamed, for they shall be naked and barefoot, and their shame shall be revealed before Egypt.
The Egyptians shall be dismayed, and the Ethiopians shall be afraid, for they shall tremble in fear.
And in that day, they that dwell in this isle shall say, “Behold, our expectation, to whom we fled for help, is turned back; how shall we be saved from the king of Assyria?”

sections.title: The prophecy which was spoken concerning Babylon, concerning Edom and Arabia.

verses.text: Concerning the wilderness, the word has been spoken; as the strong wind blows in the wilderness, so shall it come from the fearful nation, from the wilderness.

A heavy vision has been revealed to me; the wicked one shall be brought low; and the deceitful one shall be humbled. The men of Elam and the messenger of the Medes shall come upon me. Yet today, I am troubled; I shall be steadfast.
Therefore, my body is filled with pain; as a woman in labor, I am seized with anguish; from my sickness, I cannot hear; from my distress, I cannot rise.
My heart is troubled; my sin has overwhelmed me; my body is filled with anguish.
Prepare the table; make ready; drink; O you rulers, arise; prepare the couch.
The Lord has spoken thus to me: "Hasten, go; stop the watchman; let him speak what he sees; let him declare what he hears."
I saw two horsemen as they rode; one was on a horse, and the other was seated on a mule; but their voices were as the voices of many horsemen.
The watchman of the Lord, Uriah, was called; and he said, "Behold, I am here; I stand upon the watchtower by day and by night."
Behold, they shall come, horsemen who ride two by two; he cried out, and he answered, "Babylon has fallen! It has fallen! And all her idols, all her works of hands, are cast down upon the earth."
O you who are cast down and receive affliction, the God of Israel, the Lord of hosts, hear what I have spoken and what I have heard.
ስለ ኤዶምያስ የተነገረ ነገር። አንዱ ከሴይር፥ “ጕበኛ ሆይ፥ ሌሊቱ ምን ያህል ነው? ጕበኛ ሆይ፥ ሌሊቱ ምን ያህል ነው?” ብሎ ጠራኝ።
ጕበኛውም፥ “ይነጋል፤ ደግሞም ይመሻል፤ ትጠይቁ ዘንድ ብትወድዱ ጠይቁ፤ ተመልሳችሁም ኑ፥” አለ።
ሌሊትም በዲዳናውያን ጎዳና በዛፎች ውስጥ ታድራለህ፤
በቴማን የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ወደ ተጠሙት ሰዎች ውኃ አምጡ፤
እንጀራ ይዛችሁ ከሰልፍ ከሸሹ ከብዙ ሰዎችና በጦር ከጠፉ ከብዙ ሰዎች፥ ፍላጻ ከያዙ ከብዙ ሰዎችና ጦር ከያዙ ከብዙ ሰዎች፥ ቀስቶቻቸው ከተሳቡና በሰልፍ ከወደቁ ከብዙ ሰዎች ያመለጡትን ተቀበሏቸው።
እግዚአብሔር እንደ ገና እንዲህ ብሎኛልና፥ “እንደ ምንደኛ ዓመት በአንድ ዓመት ውስጥ የቄዳር ልጆች ክብር ሁሉ ይጠፋል፤
ከቀስተኞች ቍጥር የቀሩት፥ የቄዳር ልጆች ኀያላን፥ ያንሳሉ፤” የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ተናግሮአልና።

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Jerusalem.

verses.text: Concerning Zion, a word has been spoken. O all of you, what has become of you today as you go forth in vain to the wilderness?
O city filled with cries and lamentations, your oppressors shall not be slain by the sword; for those who are slain within you are not slain by the sword.
Yet your leaders all flee together; they have been trampled underfoot by those who are strong, and your mighty ones have retreated far away.
Therefore, I have said, "Leave me, for I am in bitterness; do not hinder me from crying out for the daughter of my people."
From the Lord of hosts, from the God of Israel, the day of punishment and destruction, of ruin and devastation, has come upon Zion. Both the small and the great shall be taken away upon the mountain.
The men of Elam have borne their shields; they have mounted on horses, and the archers have been in their ranks.
Your beautiful valleys have been filled with their tents; the horsemen have made their encampments upon your gates.
The gates of Judah shall be opened; and on that day the houses of the city shall be plundered. The storehouses of David shall also be opened.
The city of David shall not be forsaken, for the inhabitants shall not be few; the waters of the lower pool shall be made to flow within the city.
You have numbered the houses of Jerusalem; and to strengthen the wall, you have broken down the houses.
በአሮጌው ኵሬ ላለው ውኃ በሁለቱ ቅጥር መካከል መከማቻ ሠራችሁ፤ ይህን ያደረገውን ግን አልተመለከታችሁም፤ ቀድሞ የሠራውንም አላያችሁም።
በዚያም ቀን የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ልቅሶንና ዋይታን፥ ራስን መንጨትንና ማቅን መልበስን ጠራ።
እነሆም፥ በዓልን፥ ደስታንና ሐሴትን አደረጋችሁ፤ በሬዎችንና በጎችንም አረዳችሁ፤ “ነገ እንሞታለን፤ እንብላ፤ እንጠጣም፤” እያላችሁ ሥጋን በላችሁ፤ ወይንንም ጠጣችሁ።
ይህም ነገር በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ጆሮ ተሰማ፥ “እስክትሞቱ ድረስ ይህ በደል በእውነት አይሰረይላችሁም” ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለኝ፥ “ወደ ገንዘብ ጠባቂው ወደ ሳምናስ ሂድ እንዲህም በለው፦
መቃብር በዚያ ያስወቀርህ፥ ከፍ ባለው ስፍራ መቃብር ያሠራህ፥ በድንጋይም ውስጥ ለራስህ መኖርያ ያሳነጽህ ወደዚህ ለምን መጣህ? ለምንስ በዚህ ተደፋፈርህ?
እነሆ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በኀይል ወርውሮ ይጥልሃል፤ ያጠፋሃልም፤ ልብስህንና የክብር አክሊልህንም ይገፍሃል፤
ወደ መከራ ሀገር ይጥልሃል፤ በዚያም ትሞታለህ፤ ያማረ ሰረገላህንም ያጐሰቍለዋል፤ የአለቃህም ቤት ይረገጣል።
ከአዛዥነት ሥራህና ከሥልጣንህ ትሻራለህ።
በዚያም ቀን ባሪያዬን የኬልቅዩን ልጅ ኤልያቄምን እጠራዋለሁ፤
I shall adorn thee with thy shield; I shall give thee thy crown; I shall place thy scepter in thy hand; and it shall be for a father to those who dwell in Jerusalem and to those who dwell in Judah.

I shall bestow upon David his glory; he shall possess it; there shall be none who can surpass him. I shall establish the opening of David's house upon his throne; and he shall reign; there shall be no one who can oppose him; he shall reign, and there shall be none who can contend with him.
In a faithful place, I shall establish thee as a chosen one; in the house of thy father, I shall set a throne of honor.
The honor of thy father’s house, all his children, and the children of his children, from the smallest vessel to the largest vessel, shall be honored.

On that day, it shall be said, "Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, in the faithful place where the chosen one is established, it shall be shaken; it shall be broken; and the burden that is upon him shall be removed," for the Lord hath spoken thus.

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Tyre.

verses.text: The prophecy concerning Tyre. O ships of Chaldea, do not be afraid; for it is destroyed, and from the land of Chaldea they shall no longer come, and their ships shall be taken away.
What shall the refugees of Phoenicia, who dwell by the sea and navigate the waters, be like?
The refugees who have entered are as a seed that is cast away in the time of trouble.
O sea, O sea, the sea's abyss, "I shall not be silent, I shall not give birth; nor shall I bring forth the offspring, nor shall I nurture the young," thus it is spoken, and I am afraid.
And when the news reaches Egypt, it shall bring tidings concerning Tyre's destruction.
Flee to Chaldea; you who dwell by the sea, do not be afraid.
You have been instructed to go, for this rest is not for you.
Who is this that has brought trouble upon Tyre? Is she not the one who is fairest of all and is not to be surpassed? Her merchants are the renowned leaders of the earth.
To humble the proud, and to bring low all the proud of the earth, the Lord of hosts has decreed.
Your land shall be desolate; for now the ships shall not come from Chaldea.
The rulers whom the sea people have destroyed, their hand shall be heavy upon you; for the Lord of hosts has commanded to cut off the strength of the Canaanites.
And He said, "O daughter of Sidon, you who are troubled, rise and flee to Chittim; there shall you find no rest."
Behold, the land of the Chaldeans is laid waste; for her stronghold is fallen.
O ships of Tarshish, for your strength is laid waste; wail, you shall cry.

And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be as a forgotten city, like a woman who has lost her husband for seventy years; after seventy years, however, it shall be as the song of a harlot.
O you forgotten harlot, make sweet melody; let your songs be heard round about the city, for you shall be remembered as a harlot; your song shall be multiplied.
After seventy years, the Lord shall visit Tyre with mercy; and she shall return to her former state; and she shall be a harlot for all the kingdoms of the world.

Her merchandise and her hire shall be holy to the Lord; her trade shall be for those who dwell before the Lord, for eating and for drinking, for being remembered before the Lord, but it shall not be treasured by them.

sections.title: The judgment of the Lord upon the earth.

verses.text: Behold, the Lord shall destroy the earth; He shall make it desolate; He shall make it bare; and He shall smite those who dwell therein.

The people shall be as the priest, and the servant as his master; the maidservant shall be as her mistress; he who sells shall be as he who buys; the debtor shall be as the creditor; and he who is in distress shall be as he who is in debt.
Behold, the earth is about to be shaken; it shall be greatly moved; for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken thus.
The earth is broken; it is utterly dissolved; the world is shaken; the mighty ones of the earth are broken.
The earth is defiled because of those who dwell therein; for they have transgressed the law, changed the ordinance, and broken the everlasting covenant.
Therefore the earth shall be desolate; for those who dwell therein are guilty; and the inhabitants of the earth shall be troubled; but few men shall be left.
The wine is mourned; the vine is languished; all the merry-hearted do sigh.
The joy of the joyful is ceased; the mirth of the merry is gone; the wealth of the wicked is ceased; the sound of the joyful is no more.
Woe to those who drink wine; bitter is the drink for those who drink it.
All cities shall be desolate; and all houses shall be shut up, that no man may enter.
Therefore, let not the wine be poured out in abundance; for all the joy of the earth is consumed, and the happiness of the earth has fled away.
The cities shall be desolate; the houses shall be empty and forsaken; they shall be destroyed.
All this shall come to pass within the land among the nations. As the fruit of the vine is gathered in the season of harvest, so shall the children of Israel be gathered.
These shall lift up their voices; and those who remain upon the earth shall rejoice in the glory of the Lord in unity; the waters of the sea shall be poured out.
Therefore, the glory of the Lord shall be upon the islands of the sea; and the name of the Lord shall be exalted.
O Lord God of Israel, we have heard the wondrous hope of the righteous from the borders of the earth. Yet they say, "Woe to those who transgress the law of the Lord!"
Upon the earth, there shall be fear and destruction and calamity.
The windows of heaven are opened; and the foundations of the earth are shaken; and from the voice of fear, the destruction shall fall; and from the calamity, it shall be seized.
The earth has trembled; it has been shaken; the earth has quaked; it has been moved.
The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard; it shall be moved like a cottage; its transgression shall be heavy upon it; it shall fall; and it shall not rise again.
And it shall come to pass in that day; the Lord shall extend His hand over the hosts of heaven and over the kings of the earth.
And they shall be gathered together; they shall dwell in the house of bondage; and after many generations, they shall be brought low.
Their towers shall be brought down; their walls shall fall; for the Lord of hosts shall be exalted in mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and He shall be glorified before His elders.

sections.title: Psalm of Praise

verses.text: እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ፥ ድንቅ ነገርን የዱሮ እውነተኛ ምክርን አድርገሃልና አከብርሃለሁ፤ ስምህንም አመሰግናለሁ።
ከተሞችን ትቢያ አደረግህ፤ የተመሸጉ ከተሞችን፥ የኃጥኣንንም መሠረት አፈረስህ፤ ከተሞቻቸውም ለዘለዓለም አይሠሩም።
ስለዚህ ድሆች ወገኖች ያከብሩሃል፤ የተገፉ ሰዎች ከተሞችም ያከብሩሃል።
ለተዋረዱ ሰዎች ከተሞች ረዳት ሆነሃልና፥ በችግራቸው የተጨነቁትን በደስታ ጋረድሃቸው፤ ከክፉዎች ሰዎችም አዳንሃቸው፤ ለተጠሙት ጥላ ሆንሃቸው፤ ለተገፉትም ሕይወት ሆንሃቸው።
ለእነርሱ አሳልፈህ ከሰጠኸን ከኃጥኣን ሰዎች የተነሣ በጽዮን እንደ ተጠሙ አእምሮአቸውን እንዳጡ ሰዎች ሆነናል።
የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ግብዣን ያደርጋል፤ በዚህ ተራራ ላይ ሐሤትን ያደርጋሉ፤ የወይን ጠጅንም ይጠጣሉ፤ ዘይትንም ይቀባሉ።
በዚህም ተራራ ላይ ይህን ሁሉ ለአሕዛብ ሰጠ፤ ምክሩ ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ ናትና።
ሞት ሰዎችን ዋጠ፤ በረታም፤ እንደ ገናም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ከፊት ሁሉ እንባን ያብሳል፤ የሕዝቡንም ስድብ ከምድር ሁሉ ላይ ያስወግዳል፤ እግዚአብሔር በአፉ ተናግሮአልና።
በዚያም ቀን፥ “እነሆ፥ አምላካችን ይህ ነው፤ ተስፋ አድርገነዋል፤ ያድናልም፤ እግዚአብሔር ይህ ነው፤ ጠብቀነዋል፤ በመዳናችንም ደስ ይለናል፤ ሐሤትም እናደርጋለን” ይላሉ።
እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ተራራ ላይ ዕረፍትን ይሰጠናል፤ እህልም በመንኰራኵር ጭድም በጭቃ እንደሚበራይ እንዲሁ ሞዓብ ይረገጣል።
He shall raise His hand against him, as he has done wickedly, and He shall bring destruction upon him; and upon him shall His hand be raised, and he shall be made desolate.
He has brought low that which was exalted, and He has made your high fortress to be brought down. He shall cast it down; even to the ground shall it be brought low, even to the dust.

sections.title: The Lord shall grant victory to His people.

verses.text: In that day, this song shall be sung in the land of Judah: Behold, we have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
A people that keeps justice and does righteousness shall enter through the gates.
For upon Thee do I wait; and the soul that trusts in Thee, Thou dost keep in perfect peace.
The Lord God is an everlasting rock; trust in the Lord forever, for in the Lord God is everlasting strength.
Thou dost bring low those who dwell on high; the lofty city dost Thou lay low; even to the ground dost Thou bring it down, even to the dust.
The feet of the humble shall tread it down.
The way of the righteous is level; the path of the righteous dost Thou make smooth.
The way of the Lord is upright; in His holy name do we trust; our souls have found what they longed for.
O Lord, my God, Thy command is light upon the earth, and my soul seeks Thee in the night. Let those who dwell on the earth learn to do righteousness.
Upon the earth, the wicked do not learn righteousness, nor do they do good; they are like those who do not see the glory of the Lord, and the sinful are cast down.
O Lord, I have not known the height of Thy shoulder; if I were to know, I would fear. The proud have taken hold of men with deceit; even now, fire consumes the adversaries.
O Lord, our God, Thou hast given us all things; grant us peace.
O Lord, our God, Thou art our possession; apart from Thee, we know not another; we call upon Thy name.
Yet the dead see not life; nor do the healers revive them; therefore, Thou hast taken them away; Thou hast caused them to perish; and all their men Thou hast cast away.
O Lord, add iniquity to them; add iniquity to the great of the earth.
O Lord, in the time of my affliction, I have thought of Thee; in a little affliction, Thou hast distressed me.
As a woman in labor cries out and is in anguish, O Lord, so have I become before Thee for my beloved.
In fearing Thee, O Lord, we have been strengthened; we are held fast; and upon the earth, Thy spirit of salvation is born; those who dwell in the world shall perish.
The dead shall rise; those in the grave shall awaken. And those who dwell upon the earth shall rejoice; for their healer is found in Thee; Thou shalt destroy the land of the wicked.
My people, arise; and enter into thy house; shut thy door behind thee; and until the wrath of the Lord has passed, hide thyself for a little while.
እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ ከመቅደሱ መቅሠፍቱን ያመጣል፤ ምድርም ደምዋን ትገልጣለች፤ ሙታኖችዋንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አትከድንም።

sections.title: Concerning the land of Israel.

verses.text: በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር በፈጣኑ እባብ ደራጎን ላይ፥ በክፉውም እባብ ደራጎን ላይ ልዩ፥ ታላቅና ብርቱ ሰይፍን ያመጣል። በባሕርም ውስጥ ያለውን ዘንዶ ይገድለዋል።
በዚያም ቀን ለተወደደው የወይን ቦታ ተቀኙለት።
እኔ የጸናች ከተማ ነኝ፤ አንድዋን ከተማ ይወጋሉ። በከንቱ አጠጣኋት፤ በሌሊት ትጠመዳለች፤ በቀንም ግድግዳዋ ይወድቃል፤ የሚያነሣትም የለም።
ስለ ጠቡ በእሳት አቃጥለው ዘንድ ቀርቃሃና ሣርን ማን በሰጠኝ! አሁንም እግዚአብሔር የተናገረውን ሁሉ ዛሬ አደረገ፤ እነርሱ ተቃጥለዋልና።
በውስጧ የሚኖሩ ይጮሃሉ፤ ከእርሱ ጋር ሰላምን እናድርግ፤ ከእርሱ ጋር ሰላምን እናድርግ።
በሚመጣው ዘመን የያዕቆብ ልጆች ሥር ይሰድዳሉ፤ እስራኤልም ያብባል፤ በፍሬያቸውም የዓለሙን ፊት ይሞላሉ።
በውኑ የመቱትን እንደ መታ እንዲሁ እርሱን መታውን? ወይስ እነርሱ እንደ ተገደሉበት መገደል እርሱ ተገድሎአልን?
በጠብና በንቀት ይሰዳቸዋል፤ በቍጣና በክፉ መንፈስ ትገሥጻቸው ዘንድ ትጀምራለህን?
ስለዚህም የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችና የፀሐይ ምስሎች ዳግመኛ እንዳይነሡ የመሠዊያውን ድንጋይ ሁሉ እንደ ደቀቀ እንደ ኖራ ድንጋይ ባደረገ ጊዜ ፥ እንዲሁ የያዕቆብ በደል ይሰረያል፤ ይህም ኀጢአትን የማስወገድ ፍሬ ሁሉ ነው።
በዚያም የተሰማራው መንጋ እንደ ተተወ መንጋ ይሆናል፤ ምድሩም ለብዙ ዘመን መሰማሪያ ይሆናል፤ በዚያም መንጋው ይሰማራል፤ ያርፋልም።

The wicked shall be cut off; within them, all their deceit shall not be found; O ye daughters that come from the land of Tyre, let not your beauty be for my people; for it is a people that does not understand; therefore, the Creator shall not have compassion upon them; neither shall the Maker show them mercy.
In that day it shall be said: The Lord shall stretch forth His hand from the river of Egypt to the river of Egypt; and you, O children of Israel, shall gather together, one by one.

In that day it shall be said: A great trumpet shall be blown; and those who were lost in Assyria, and those who were driven out of the land of Egypt, shall come; and upon the holy mountain in Jerusalem, they shall worship the Lord.

sections.title: A warning concerning Ephraim.

verses.text: For Ephraim, the crown of pride, which is like a fading flower upon the head of the fertile valley, is a glorious adornment, O woe!
Behold, the mighty and strong hand of the Lord shall descend with power like a hailstorm, and like a destroying wind, and like a flood of many waters, it shall be cast down upon the earth.
The crown of pride of Ephraim shall be trampled underfoot by hand and by foot;
Upon the lofty mountain, there stands the fading flower of its glory; as it withers, it shall be as a gathering of thorns; and when a man shall not behold it, it shall be consumed without his hand.
In that day, the Lord of hosts shall be for the remnant of His people a glorious diadem and a crown of hope.
For judgment and for those who are saved from destruction, strength shall remain in the spirit of judgment.

And these also shall be ashamed, who have risen from wine; they shall be like those who are overcome by strong drink; the priest and the prophet, who have risen from strong drink, shall be ashamed; they shall stumble in wine; they shall be overcome by strong drink; this is the vision of the eyes; they shall be confounded in judgment.
The sanctuary is filled with vanity and wickedness; there is no place that is pure.
To whom shall we speak? And to whom shall we proclaim? Shall we speak to the weary or to the faint-hearted?
Sickness upon sickness, hope upon hope, they shall receive; little here, little there shall be.
In a foreign tongue, He shall speak to this people;
And He said, “This is a rest for the weary; this is a refreshing;” but they would not hear.

Therefore, they shall go backward and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken; for the word of the Lord shall be upon them as a sickness upon the sick, as hope upon the hopeful; a little here, a little there shall be their portion.

sections.title: The stone of the cornerstone of Zion.

verses.text: Therefore, O ye people who have been ensnared, and ye rulers who dwell in Jerusalem, hearken to the word of the Lord God.

And ye say, "We have made a covenant with Sheol; and with death we are in agreement; we have made lies our refuge, and in falsehood have we taken shelter; when the overwhelming scourge passes through, it shall not come unto us."
Therefore, the Lord God saith, "Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation; he that believeth shall not make haste."
I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plummet; and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.
The covenant which ye have made with death shall be disannulled; and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.
It shall sweep away your refuge, and the morning shall come upon you as a thief in the night; it shall be a time of evil at night; and ye shall be dismayed; learn to hear.
We cannot escape; we are but weaklings to gather you.

And the Lord shall rise up as in Mount Perazim; he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act; for his wrath is terrible.
Even now, upon all the earth, I have heard the word of the Lord from the host of the Lord, and I have heard that your strength shall not prevail against you, and ye shall not rejoice.
Give ear; hear my voice; hearken, and make your heart attentive; and listen to my speech.
Is the true farmer not always diligent in sowing? Or does he sow the seed before the earth is prepared? Does he not also cultivate his fields?
When the field is tended, does not the little grain of wheat sprout, along with the barley, and the millet, and the various seeds that are sown in their respective places?
The earth rejoices in the judgment of the Lord; it is glad.

The little grain of wheat does not perish in a well-tended field; nor does the millet fail to thrive upon the earth; however, the little grain of wheat, when it is sown, will yield abundantly, and the barley will also be fruitful.
I shall not condemn you forever; nor shall the voice of my mercy be silenced against you.
This is indeed a marvelous counsel, from Him who gives advice, and it is still from the Lord God of hosts. But you, do not cling to vain hopes, for you shall be better off.

sections.title: Concerning the city of Jerusalem, let it be honored.

verses.text: ዳዊት ለሰፈረባት ከተማ ለአርኤል ወዮላት! የዓመቱን አዝመራ ሰብስቡ፤ ከሞዓብ ጋር ትበላላችሁና።
አርኤልንም አስጨንቃለሁ፤ ይህችም ኀይል፥ ይህችም ብዕል የእኔ ትሆናለች፥
እንደ ዳዊትም እከብሻለሁ፤ በቅጥርም አጥርሻለሁ፤ አንባም በላይሽ አቆማለሁ።
ነገርሽም በምድር ውስጥ ይሰጥማል፤ ቃልሽም ከምድር በታች እንደሚናገር ይሆናል፤ ትደክሚያለሽ፤ ቃልሽም በምድር ውስጥ ዝቅ ይላል።
ነገር ግን የኃጥአን ብልጽግና እንደ ደቀቀ ትቢያ፥ የጠላቶችሽም ብዛት ነፋስ እንደሚያመጣው ገለባ ይሆናል።
ድንገትም ፈጥኖ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በነጐድጓድ፥ በምድርም መናወጥ፥ በታላቅ ድምፅ፥ በዐውሎ ነፋስም፥ በወጨፎም፥ በምትበላም በእሳት ነበልባል ይጐበኛታል።
በአርኤልም ላይ የሚዋጉ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም የሚወጉ፥ በእርሻዋም ላይ የሚሰበሰቡ የሚያስጨንቋትም፥ የአሕዛብ ሁሉ ብልጽግና እንደሚያልም ሰው ሕልም ነው።
ሰዎች ተርበው ሌሊት በሕልማቸው ይበላሉ፤ ይጠጣሉም፤ በተነሡ ጊዜ ግን ሕልማቸው ከንቱ ነው። የተጠማ ሰውም እንደሚጠጣ ያልማል፤ በነቃም ጊዜ እንደ ተጠማ ነው፤ ነፍሱም በከንቱ ትመኛለች። ደብረ ጽዮንን የሚዋጉ የአሕዛብ ብልጽግናም እንደዚሁ ነው።
ደከሙ፤ ደነገጡም፤ ሰከሩም፤ በወይን አይይደለም፤ በጠጅም አይደለም።
እግዚአብሔር የእንቅልፍ መንፈስን አፍስሶባቸዋል፤ ዐይኖቻቸውን፥ የነቢያትንም ዐይን፥ የተሰወረውንም የሚያዩ የአለቆቻቸውን ዐይን ጨፍኖባቸዋል።
ይህም ሁሉ ነገር እንደ ታተመ መጽሐፍ ቃል ሆኖባቸዋል፤ ማንበብንም ለሚያውቅ፥ “ይህን አንብብ” ብለው በሰጡት ጊዜ እርሱ፥ “ታትሟልና ማንበብ አልችልም” ይላቸዋል፤
ደግሞም መጽሐፉን ማንበብን ለማያውቅ፥ “ይህን አንብብ” ብለው በሰጡት ጊዜ እርሱ፥ “ማንበብ አላውቅም” ይላቸዋል።
ጌታም አለ፥ “ይህ ሕዝብ በከንፈሮቹ ያከብረኛልና፥ ልቡ ግን ከእኔ የራቀ ነውና፥ በከንቱ ያመልኩኛል፤ ሰው ሠራሽ ትምህርትም ያስተምራሉ፤
ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ይህ ሕዝብ በድጋሚ እንዲፈልስ አደርጋለሁ፤ አፈልሳቸዋለሁም፤ የጥበበኞችንም ጥበብ አጠፋለሁ፤ የአስተዋዮችንም ማስተዋል እሰውራለሁ።”
ምክራቸውን ጥልቅ አድርገው ከእግዚአብሔር ለሚሰውሩ ወዮላቸው! ሥራቸውንም በጨለማ ውስጥ አድርገው፥ “ማን ያየናል? ወይስ ማን ያውቀናል?” ለሚሉ ወዮላቸው!
ይህ የእናንተ ጠማምነት ነው፤ እንደ ሸክላ ሠሪ ጭቃ የምትቈጠሩ አይደላችሁምን? በውኑ ሥራ ሠሪውን፥ “አልሠራኸኝም” ይለዋልን? ወይስ የተደረገ አድራጊውን፥ “በማስተዋል አላሳመርኸኝም” ይለዋልን?
ሊባኖስ እንደ ፍሬያማ እርሻ ሊለወጥ፥ ፍሬያማውም እርሻ እንደ ዱር ሊቈጠር ጥቂት ዘመን የቀረ አይይደለምን?
በዚያም ቀን ደንቆሮች የመጽሐፍን ቃል ይሰማሉ፤ በጨለማና በጭጋግ ውስጥም የዕውሮች ዐይኖች ያያሉ።
ነዳያን ደስታቸውን በእግዚአብሔር ያበዛሉ፤ በሰዎች መካከል ተስፋ የሌላቸውም ሐሤትን በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ያደርጋሉ።
ኃጥእ ሰው አልቆአልና፥ ትዕቢተኛውም ጠፍቶአልና፥ በክፋት የበደሉም ሁሉ ይነቀላሉና፤
These are they who speak ill of man, who dwell in the shadows of deceit, and they are those who cause the righteous to stumble for vain matters.
Therefore, the Lord saith concerning Abraham, concerning Jacob's house, “Jacob shall not now be forsaken; neither shall thy face now be turned away.”
Yet when his children see the work of My hand, they shall honor My name; they shall also honor the holy one of Jacob; and they shall fear the God of Israel.
In spirit, they shall know the understanding of the wise; they shall learn the discipline of those who are instructed; and they shall learn to speak peace as a gentle word.”

sections.title: For the belief in Egypt is in vain, for it is of no substance.

verses.text: Woe unto the children of the oppressors! Thus saith the Lord God; they counsel against me that which is not good; and they add sin upon sin, to break the covenant that is not of my spirit.
Without asking of me, they shall be aided by the power of Pharaoh, and they shall be kept in Egypt, and they shall go unto Egypt.
Therefore, the power of Pharaoh shall be a snare, and in Egypt, it shall be a stumbling block unto you.
Though the rulers be mighty in their strength, and though the messengers reach unto the heights,
All of them shall be confounded, for they cannot prevail; for mercy and stumbling shall be, but deliverance and abundance shall not be for the people, and they shall be afraid.

sections.title: In the wilderness, a vision was seen concerning the beasts that dwell therein.

verses.text: The lion and the serpent, and the asp, they shall all be gathered together, and they shall go forth to a people that cannot be saved, in the land of affliction and distress, where their strength shall be as a burden upon the young ones, and their treasures shall be as a weight upon the burdens of the weak.
The help of Egypt is vain and empty; therefore, declare unto them, "Your counsel is vain."
Now, be still; for the coming age shall be for eternity, and write it upon the tablet, and within the book.

sections.title: The people of the covenant.

verses.text: Behold, those who are deceitful are children of falsehood; for they do not heed the law of the Lord.
The prophets say, "Do not prophesy to us; do not speak to us of visions; rather, lead us into error, and speak to us."
"Turn from this way; do not let us hear of it; cast away the holy teachings of Israel from us," they say.

Therefore, the Holy One of Israel says, "I have spoken this word to you, for you have placed your hope in falsehood and deceit, and you have been led astray by it; in this word, you shall find your faith."
Therefore, this shall be as a snare for your destruction, as a sudden calamity shall come upon you like a wall of a city.
You shall be like a withered vine, and as a broken vessel; there shall be no place to hide from the fire of the furnace, nor shall there be a place to quench the thirst from the depths.

The Holy One of Israel, the Lord God, says this: "If you are silent and do not listen, you shall be saved; wherever you are, you shall know; for you trust in vain, and your strength shall be in vain; yet you do not heed to listen."

But you say, "We shall flee on horseback," yet this shall not be so; therefore, you shall flee; and again, you say, "We shall ride swiftly on swift horses," yet this shall not be so; therefore, swift pursuers shall be upon you.
A thousand shall flee at the rising of one man; and you shall be as a sign upon the mountaintop, and as a beacon upon the heights, until you remain; yet many shall flee at the rising of five men.
Our God is a consuming fire; therefore, the Lord shall arise to defend you; He shall lift you high; all who trust in Him shall be blessed.
The holy people shall dwell within Jerusalem; they shall not be forsaken; have mercy upon me, O Lord; in the time of their forsaking, let mercy be shown; for I have heard their cries.
And the Lord shall provide thee with the bread of affliction and the water of adversity. They who trouble thee shall no longer approach thee; yet thine eyes shall behold those who trouble thee.
Whether to the right or to the left, behind thee shall be heard the voices of those who lead thee astray.

They are those who say, "Let us go to the gold and to the silver, to the idols and to the altars;" at that time they shall be as a withered branch; like water, they shall be scattered; and among them, they shall be consumed by the destroyers.
The earth shall yield its increase to the seed that is sown; from the earth shall come forth bread and abundance; and on that day, thy cattle shall graze in a wide and open pasture.
The land shall be devoured by the cattle and the beasts, by the wild and by the free, that which is mingled with the dust shall be consumed.
In the great day of calamity, when the mountains shall tremble, upon every high hill and upon every lofty height, there shall be rivers and streams of water.

The Lord shall gather the people in the day of His visitation; in the day of His judgment, the brightness of the moon shall be as the brightness of the sun, and the brightness of the sun shall be as the light of seven days.

Behold, the name of the Lord shall come forth after many days; His wrath shall be as a consuming fire with glory; His word shall be as a fire that consumes; and the wrath of the Lord shall be as a burning flame.

And the nations shall be scattered for their vain deeds, as a whirlwind sweeps away the chaff; even to the neck shall it reach, and as water shall it overflow; their deeds shall follow them; they shall be taken captive.

As they honor the feast, shall it not be fitting for you to always rejoice and to go unto the holy place? It is right that you should go to the mountain of the Lord, where joy is proclaimed unto Israel.

The Lord shall hear the voice of the trumpet; He shall reveal the terror of the mighty, in His fierce wrath and in the consuming fire, in the tempest and in the stormy wind, and in the hailstones shall He be made known.
Assyria shall be shaken by the voice of the Lord; it shall tremble at His command.
The Lord shall bring down upon them the appointed destruction; all shall be as a great storm and a tempest; in battle shall He break their strength.

From ancient times, a place of destruction has been prepared; it is made ready for the king; it is deep and wide; fire and much wood are laid in it; the wrath of the Lord shall be as a river of brimstone poured out upon it.

sections.title: The Lord shall keep Jerusalem as a guardian.

verses.text: ርዳታ ለመፈለግ ወደ ግብፅ ለሚወርዱ፥ በፈረሶችና በሰረገሎችም ለሚታመኑ ወዮላቸው! ፈረሰኞቹ ብዙዎች ናቸውና፤ በእስራኤልም ቅዱስ አልታመኑምና፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አልፈለጉምና።
እርሱ ግን ጠቢብ ነው፤ ክፉንም ነገር በላያቸው ያመጣል፤ ቃሉንም አይመልስም፤ በክፉዎችም ሰዎች ቤት ላይ በከንቱ ተስፋቸውም ላይ ይነሣል።
ግብፃውያን ሰዎች እንጂ አምላክ አይደሉም፤ ፈረሶቻቸውም ሥጋ እንጂ መንፈስ አይደሉም፤ እግዚአብሔርም በእነርሱ ላይ እጁን በዘረጋ ጊዜ፥ ረጂው ይሰናከላል፤ ተረጂውም ይወድቃል፤ ሁሉም በአንድ ላይ ይጠፋሉ።

እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይለኛልና፥ “አንበሳ ወይም የአንበሳ ደቦል በንጥቂያው ላይ እንደሚያገሣ፥ ድምፁም ተራሮችን እስኪሞላ በእርሱ ላይ እንደሚጮህ፥ እረኞችም ሁሉ ሲጮሁበት ከብዛታቸው የተነሣ እንደማይፈራ፥ ከድምፃቸውም የተነሣ እንደማይደነግጥ፥ እነርሱም ከቍጣው ብዛት የተነሣ ድል እንደሚሆኑና እንደሚደነግጡ፥ እንዲሁ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ተራራና በኮረብታዋ ላይ ይዋጋ ዘንድ ይወርዳል።
እንደሚበርር ወፍ እንዲሁ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ይጋርዳታል፤ ይከልላታልም፤ ይታደጋታል፤ አልፎም ያድናታል።
ትበድሉ ዘንድ ጥልቅ ምክርን የምትመክሩ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ ተመለሱ።
በዚያም ቀን እያንዳንዳቸው እጆቻቸው የሠሩአቸውን የብሩንና የወርቁን ጣዖቶቻቸውን ይጥላሉ።
አሦርም ይወድቃል፤ የሚወድቀውም በሰው ሰይፍ አይደለም፤ የምትበላቸውም የሰው ሰይፍ አይደለችም፤ የሚሸሹም ከሰይፍ ፊት አይደለም ጐልማሶቻቸው ግን ይሸነፋሉ።
