ዓለትም ትውጣቸዋለች ድልም ይሆናሉ የሸሸም ይያዛል። በጽዮን ዘርእ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ቤቶች ያሉት ብፁዕ ነው” ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

sections.title: A king who rules in righteousness.

verses.text: እነሆ፥ ጻድቅ ንጉሥ ይነግሣል፤ መሳፍንትም በፍርድ ይገዛሉ።
ሰውም ቃሉን ይሰውራል፤ በውኃ እንደሚጠልቅም ይሰወራል፤ ክብሩም በደረቅ ምድር እንደሚፈስስ ውኃ በጽዮን ይገለጣል።
እንግዲህ በሰው አይታመኑም፤ በጆሮአቸው ያዳምጣሉ እንጂ።
የደካሞች ሰዎች ልብ ዕውቀትን ትሰማለች፤ የተብታቦችም ምላስ ፈጥና የሰላምን ነገር ትማራለች።
ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ሰነፍን አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ ግድ አይሉትም፤ ከእንግዲህ ሎሌህ ዝም በል አይልህም።
ሰነፍ ግን ስንፍናን ይናገራል፤ ልቡም ዐመፅን ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ስሕተትን ይናገር ዘንድ፥ የተራበችውንም ሰውነት ይበትን ዘንድ፥ የተጠማችንም ነፍስ ባዶ ያደርግ ዘንድ ከንቱን ያስባል።
በዐመፃቸው ነገር ድሃውን ይገድሉት ዘንድ፥ የድሆችንም ፍርድ ይገለብጡ ዘንድ የክፉዎች ሕሊና ዐመፅን ትመክራለች።
ጻድቃን ግን ጥበብን ይመክራሉ፤ ምክራቸውም ትጸናለች።
እናንተ ባለጸጎች ሴቶች ሆይ፥ ተነሡ፤ ድምፄንም ስሙ፤ እናንተ ተማምናችሁ የምትቀመጡ ሴቶች ልጆች ሆይ፥ ንግግሬን አድምጡ።
በየዓመቱ የኀዘን በዓል መታሰቢያ አድርጉ፤ ወይን መቍረጥ አልፎአል፤ ፍሬ ማከማችትም አልቆአል፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ አይመጣም።
And you, be steadfast in your dwelling; O women, adorn yourselves; put on your garments; let your adornments be in order.
For the field that is beloved shall be made desolate, and your vine shall be stripped bare.
Upon my people’s land, in their fields, thorns and thistles shall grow; and joy shall vanish from all their homes.

The city that is desolate and her houses shall become a wilderness. The wealth of the city and her beautiful houses shall be laid waste; and the jackals shall be for eternity a dwelling, and the wilderness shall rejoice, and the dragons shall be a place of rest.
This shall be, until the Spirit comes upon you, and the wilderness shall become a fruitful field; and the fruitful field shall be called a forest until it is counted.
After this, judgment shall dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness shall abide in the fruitful field.
The work of righteousness shall be peace; and righteousness shall provide a resting place; and they shall trust in it forever.
My people shall dwell in a city of peace. They shall be secure within her, and they shall flourish in brightness.
When snow falls, it shall not reach you; those who dwell under the tree shall live as those who dwell in the wilderness.
Where there is water, the cattle and the horses that graze there are holy.

sections.title: A prophecy concerning the deliverance from the adversary.

verses.text: ለሚያዋርዱአችሁ ወዮላቸው! እናንተን ግን የሚያዋርዳችሁ የለም፤ የሚወነጅላችሁ እናንተን የሚወነጅል አይደለም፤ ወንጀለኞች ይጠመዳሉ፤ ይያዛሉም፤ ብል እንደበላው ልብስም ያልቃሉ።
አቤቱ፥ ማረን፤ አንተን ተማምነናልና፤ የዐላውያን ዘራቸው ለጥፋት ነው፤ በመከራም ጊዜ መድኀኒታችን አንተ ነህ።
ከቃልህ ግርማ የተነሣ አሕዛብ ፈርተው ሸሹ፤ አሕዛብም ተበተኑ።
አንበጣ እንደሚሰበሰብ ትንሹም ትልቁም ምርኮአችሁ እንዲሁ ይሰበሰብላችኋል።
በአርያም የሚኖር ቅዱስ እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችሁ ይኖራል፤ ጽዮንም ፍርድንና ጽድቅን ተሞላች።
በድኅነታችን መዝገብ በሕግ ይሰበስቡአቸዋል፤ ጥበብና ምክር፥ ጽድቅም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ናቸው፤ እነዚህም የጽድቅ መዝገቦች ናቸው።
እነሆ እናንተ ቀድሞ ትፈሩአቸው የነበሩ በግርማችሁ ይፈሩአችኋል፤ ከእናንተም የተነሣ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ። መልእክተኞች መራራ ልቅሶን እያለቀሱ ይላካሉ፤ ሰላምንም ይለምናሉ።
መንገዶች ባድማ ሆኑ፤ የአሕዛብም መፈራት ቀረ፤ ቃል ኪዳናቸውም ፈረሰ፤ እንደ ሰውም አልተመለከታቸውም።
ምድር አለቀሰች፤ ሊባኖስ አፈረ፤ ሳሮንም እንደ ምድረ በዳ ሆነ፤ ገሊላና ቀርሜሎስ ታወቁ።
እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “አሁን እነሣለሁ፤ አሁን እከብራለሁ፤ አሁን ከፍ ከፍ እላለሁ።
ዛሬ ታያላችሁ፤ ዛሬ ታደንቃላችሁ፤ የመንፈሳችሁም ኀይል ከንቱ ይሆናል፤ እሳትም ትበላችኋለች።
አሕዛብም በእርሻ ውስጥ ተቈርጦ እንደ ተጣለና በእሳት እንደ ተቃጠለ እሾህ የተቃጠሉ ይሆናሉ።”
በሩቅ ያሉ የሠራሁትን ይሰማሉ፤ በቅርብም ያሉ ኀይሌን ያውቃሉ።
በጽዮን ያሉ ኀጢአተኞች ፈሩ፤ መንቀጥቀጥ ዝንጉዎችን ያዘ፤ እሳት እንደሚነድድ የሚነግራችሁ ማን ነው? የዘለዓለም ሀገርንስ የሚነግራችሁ ማን ነው?
በጽድቅ የሚሄድ፥ ቅን ነገርንም የሚናገር፥ በደልንና ኀጢአትን የሚጠላ፥ መማለጃን ከመጨበጥ እጁን የሚያራግፍ፥ ደም ማፍሰስን ከመስማት ጆሮቹን የሚደፍን፥ ክፋትንም ከማየት ዐይኖቹን የሚጨፍን ነው።
እርሱ ከፍ ባለ በጽኑዕ ዓለት ዋሻ ይኖራል፤ እንጀራም ይሰጠዋል፤ ውኃውም የታመነች ትሆናለች።

sections.title: Concerning the coming of the glorious age.

verses.text: ንጉሥን በክብሩ ታዩታላችሁ፤ ዐይኖቻችሁም በሩቅ ያለች ምድርን ያዩአታል።
ልባችሁም፥ “ጸሓፊዎች ወዴት አሉ? መማክርትስ ወዴት አሉ? የትንሹና የትልቁ ዐማፅያን ብዛትስ ወዴት አለ?” ብሎ ፍርሀትን ያስባል።
የማታውቋቸውን አሕዛብ አመጣባችኋለሁ፤ እናንት ዐማፅያን ሕዝብ፥ ጥልቅ ነገርን ትሰማላችሁ። የሚሰማም ማስተዋል እንደሌለው ይሆናል።
እነሆ፥ የመድኀኒታችንን ከተማ ጽዮንን ተመልከት፤ ዐይኖችህም ድንኳኖችዋ የማይናወጡ፥ ካስማዎችዋ ለዘለዓለም የማይነቀሉ፥ አውታሮችዋም ሁሉ የማይበጠሱ፥ የበለጸገች ከተማ ኢየሩሳሌምን ያያሉ።
የእግዚአብሔር ስም ለእናንተ ታላቅ ነው፤ ሀገራችሁም የሰፉ ወንዞችና ታላቅ የመስኖ ስፍራ ይሆናል፤ በዚህች መንገድ አትሄድም፤ መርከቦችም አይሄዱም።
አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነውና ቸል አይለንም፤ እግዚአብሔር ፈራጃችን ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችን ነው። እግዚአብሔር ንጉሣችን ነው፤ እርሱ እግዚአብሔር ያድነናል።
ገመዶችሽ ተበጥሰዋል፤ ጥንካሬ የላቸውምና፤ ደቀልሽ ዘመመ፤ ሸራውንም መዘርጋት አልቻለም፤ እስከሚያዝም ድረስ አላማውን አልተሸከመም። በዚያን ጊዜ የብዙ ምርኮ ተከፈለ፤ ብዙ አንካሶች እንኳ ምርኮውን ማረኩ።
በውስጣቸውም የሚቀመጥ ሕዝብ፦ ደክሜአለሁ አይልም፥ በደላቸው ይቅር ይባልላቸዋልና።

sections.title: Concerning the judgment that shall come upon the nations.

verses.text: O ye nations, draw near; and ye rulers, give heed; let all the earth and those within it, the world and all the peoples therein, hearken.
For the wrath of the Lord is upon all nations; and His indignation shall consume them, and for the sword shall they be delivered according to their number.
And those who are slain among them shall be cast forth; their carcasses shall stink; and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
The heavens shall be rolled up like a scroll; as a grape is shaken from the vine, so shall all the stars be shaken.
My sword shall be bathed in heaven; behold, it shall come down upon Edom and upon the people of my curse for judgment.

For the Lord hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom; for the sword of the Lord is filled with blood; it is made fat with the fat of lambs and goats, with the blood of the kidneys of rams.
The mighty men shall fall with them, and the youth with the men of war; their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust shall be made fat.
For the day of the Lord's vengeance is near, and the year of recompense for the controversy of Zion.
Her streams shall be turned into pitch, and her dust into brimstone; and her land shall become burning pitch; it shall not be quenched day or night; the smoke thereof shall go up forever.
It shall be desolate, and it shall remain desolate from generation to generation; it shall lie waste for many ages.
ጭልፊቶችና ጃርት፥ ጕጕትና ቍራም ይኖሩባታል፤ መሠረቷንም በመፍረስ ገመድ ይለካሉ። አጋንንትም ያድሩባታል፤
አለቆችዋ ያልቃሉ፤ ነገሥታቷና መሳፍንቷ ይጠፋሉ።
በከተማዎችዋም እሾህ፥ በቅጥሮችዋም አሜከላ ይበቅሉባታል፤ የአጋንንት ማደሪያና የሰጎን ስፍራ ትሆናለች።
በዚያም አጋንንትና ጂኖች ይገናኛሉ፤ እነርሱም እርስ በርሳቸው ይጠራራሉ፤ ጂኖችም በዚያ ይኖራሉ፤ ለራሳቸውም ማረፊያን ያገኛሉ።
በዚያ ጃርቶች ይዋለዳሉ፤ ምድርም ልጆችዋን በኀይል ታድናለች፤ ዋሊያዎች በዚያ ይገናኛሉ፤ ፊት ለፊትም ይተያያሉ።
በየቍጥራቸው ያልፋሉ፤ ከእነርሱም አንዱ አይጠፋም፤ እርስ በርሳቸው አይተጣጡም፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር አዝዞአቸዋልና መንፈሱም ሰብስቦአቸዋልና።
እርሱም ዕጣ ጣለባቸው፤ እጁም ከፈለችላቸው፤ ለዘለዓለም ይሰማሩባታል፤ ከትውልድም እስከ ትውልድ ድረስ ይወርሱአታል፤ በውስጥዋም ያርፉባታል።

sections.title: The joy of the people of Dan.

verses.text: The wilderness that is thirsty shall rejoice; the desert shall be glad, and it shall blossom as the rose.

The wilderness of the Jordan shall blossom; it shall bring forth joy; the glory of Lebanon and the glory of Carmel shall be given to it; and my people shall see the glory of the Lord, the majesty of God.
The hands of the weak and the knees that are feeble, be strong.
You who have no strength, strengthen your hearts; be strong; fear not; behold, your God will come with vengeance; He will come and save you.
At that time, the eyes of the blind shall be opened; and the ears of the deaf shall hear.
At that time, the lame shall leap like a deer; and the tongue of the mute shall sing; for in the wilderness, waters shall break forth, and streams in the desert.
The parched land shall become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water; the habitation of jackals shall become a resting place for reeds and rushes.
And there shall be a highway there, and it shall be called the Way of Holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those; the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
No lion shall be there, nor shall any ravenous beast go up thereon; it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there.
And the ransomed of the Lord shall return, and come to Zion with singing; and everlasting joy shall be upon their heads; they shall obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

sections.title: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds His people.

verses.text: And it came to pass, in the days of King Hezekiah, in the fourteenth year of his reign, that Sennacherib, king of Assyria, came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.
And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah in Jerusalem, with a great army; and he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field.
And Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, went out to him.
And Rabshakeh said unto them, “Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?”
“Sayest thou, but they are but vain words? I have counsel and strength for war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?”
Behold, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust in him.

But if thou say unto me, We trust in the Lord our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
Now therefore, give pledges, I pray thee, to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
And now, behold, thou hast come up against the land to destroy it; and the Lord said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.”

And Eliakim and Shebna, and Joah said, “We hear you; please speak to your servants in the Syrian language, for we understand it; and do not speak to us in the Hebrew language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”
But Rabshakeh said, “Is it for your master and for you that my lord sent me to speak these words? And not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat and drink their own waste with you?”
Then Rabshakeh stood and cried out with a loud voice in Hebrew, saying, “Hear the words of the great king of Assyria!
Thus says the king: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you.’
And Hezekiah said, “The Lord will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

Do not listen to Hezekiah; for thus says the king of Assyria: ‘Make peace with me by a present and come out to me; and every one of you eat from his own vine and every one from his own fig tree, and drink every one the waters of his own cistern;
until I come and take you away to a land like your own, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.’
Hezekiah said, “The Lord our God will deliver us; do not let him deceive you.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?
Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
Who among all the gods of these lands have delivered their countries from my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem from my hand?”
And they were silent; none answered him a word; for the king was greatly troubled by their silence.

The chief of the house of Hilkiah, Eliakim, and the scribe of the army, Shebnah, and the scribe of the chronicles, Joah, the son of Asaph, they tore their garments and went to Hezekiah, and they spoke to him the words of Rabshakeh.

sections.title: Hezekiah sought the counsel of Isaiah.

verses.text: And it came to pass, when King Hezekiah heard this, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.
And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.
And they said unto him, “Hezekiah thus saith: ‘This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy; for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.’”

Perhaps the Lord thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the Lord thy God hath heard; therefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.”
And so it was, when the king's servants came to Isaiah,

Isaiah said unto them, “Thus shall ye say to your master: ‘Thus saith the Lord: Be not afraid of the words of the Assyrian, which thou hast heard, wherein the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.’”
Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumor, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”
And the king of Assyria heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “He is come out to fight against thee.” And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
“Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying: ‘Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, “Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”’”
Behold, how have the kings of Assyria brought desolation upon all the earth, and have you not heard of it? Will you not be steadfast?
Did not the fathers bring desolation upon them, the goats and the rams that are in Teman, and the gods of the nations have they not cast down?
Where are the kings of Hamath and Arpad, and the city of Sepharvaim, and the kings of Hezeq and Iva?
And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and he read it; and Hezekiah went up to the house of the Lord and spread it before the Lord.
And Hezekiah prayed unto the Lord, saying,
"O Lord, God of Israel, that dwellest between the cherubim, Thou art the God, even Thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; Thou hast made heaven and earth.
O Lord, incline Thine ear and hear; O Lord, open Thine eyes and see, and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.
Truly, O Lord, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries;
And have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.
Now, therefore, O Lord our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that Thou art the Lord God, even Thou only."

sections.title: The Fall of Satan

verses.text: The son of Amotz, Isaiah, was sent to Hezekiah; and he said, “Thus says the Lord God of Israel: I have heard your prayer concerning Sennacherib, king of Assyria.”
The word which the Lord spoke concerning him is this: “The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you; she has laughed you to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.”
Who is it that you have reproached and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel you have not done this.

And you shall say to him, “Thus says the Lord: ‘Because of your multitude of chariots, you have gone up to the heights of your mountains, to the farthest recesses of Lebanon; you cut down its tall cedars, the choice cypress trees; you have come down to the dwelling of the mountains, to the forest of its fruitful field.’”
I will dry up your rivers and your pools.
“Have you not heard that which I did of old? In former days I prepared it; now I bring it to pass, that you should be for crushing fortified cities into heaps of ruins.”
I will lift my hand against them; they shall be as stubble; they shall be like dry grass before the fire.
But now I know your dwelling place and your going out and your coming in, and your rage against me.
Because your rage against me and your tumult have come up to my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way in which you came.

“And this shall be a sign to you: You shall eat this year such as grows of itself, and in the second year what springs from that; but in the third year sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat the fruit of them.”
The house of Judah shall be made desolate; its root shall be cast down to the earth, and it shall be torn asunder above.
For they shall be led away from Jerusalem, and from the mountain of Zion; for the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, shall perform this.

Therefore, the Lord concerning the king of Assyria shall say thus: "He shall not come unto this city, nor shall he shoot an arrow against it; nor shall he come before it with a shield, nor shall he cast a mound against it."
And he shall return by the way he came; and concerning this city, the Lord saith, "He shall not come unto it."
As for me, and for my servant David, I shall defend this city and deliver it."
And the angel of the Lord went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and eighty-five thousand men; and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
And the king of Assyria, Sennacherib, arose and went; and he returned and dwelt at Nineveh.
And in the house of his god, they slew his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And his son Esarhaddon reigned in his stead.

sections.title: The sickness of Hezekiah and his healing.

verses.text: In those days, Hezekiah became ill to the point of death. And the prophet Isaiah, the son of Amoz, came to him and said, "Thus says the Lord: You shall die, and not live; set your house in order."
And Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord, saying,
"O Lord, remember now how I have walked before You in truth and with a loyal heart, and have done what is good in Your sight." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
And the word of the Lord came to Isaiah, saying,
"Go, and tell Hezekiah, 'Thus says the Lord, the God of David your father: I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears; surely I will add to your days fifteen years.
I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city.'
And this shall be the sign to you from the Lord, that the Lord will do this thing which He has spoken:
Behold, I will bring the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down with the sun on the sundial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees on the dial by which it had gone down."

sections.title: The Prayer of Hezekiah, King of Judah.

verses.text: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ታምሞ ከደዌው በተፈወሰ ጊዜ የጸለየው ጸሎት ይህ ነው፦
እኔ እንዲህ አልሁ፥ “በሕይወት ዘመኔ መካከል ወደ ሲኦል በሮች እገባለሁ፤
ደግሞም፦ በሕያዋን ምድር የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን፤
የቀረውንም ኑሬዬን አጣሁ።
በዚያ ወራት እስኪነጋ ድረስ እንደ አንበሳ ታወክሁ፤
እንደ ሸመላ እንዲሁ ጮህሁ፤
ዐይኖች ደከሙ፤ ወደ ሰማይም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ማየት አልቻልሁም።
ጌታ ሆይ፥ ስለ እርስዋ እንዲህ አልሁህ፤ ነፍሴን አዳንሃት፤
ሰውነቴንም እንዳትጠፋ ይቅር አልሃት፤
በመቃብር የሚኖሩ አያመሰግኑህምና፤
እኔ ዛሬ እንደማደርግ ሕያዋን ብቻ ያመሰግኑሃል፤
ጌታዬ ሆይ አንተ መድኀኒቴ ነህ፤
ኢሳይያስም ሕዝቅያስን እንዲህ አለው፥ “የበለስ ጥፍጥፍ አምጥተህ በእባጩ ላይ ለብጠው፤ አንተም ትፈወሳለህ።”
ሕዝቅያስም፥ “ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እወጣ ዘንድ ምልክቱ ምንድን ነው?” ብሎ ነበር።

sections.title: The messengers who came from Babylon.

verses.text: በዚያም ወራት የባቢሎን ንጉሥ የባልዳን ልጅ መሮዳክ ባልዳን ሕዝቅያስ ታምሞ እንደ ተፈወሰ ሰምቶ ነበርና ደብዳቤና እጅ መንሻን፥ መልእክተኞችንም ላከለት።
ሕዝቅያስም ስለ እነርሱ እጅግ ደስ አለው፤ ግምጃ ቤቱንም፥ ወርቁንና ብሩን፥ ከርቤውንና ዕጣኑን፥ ዘይቱንም፥ መሣሪያም ያለበትን ቤት ሁሉ፥ ልብሱንና ዕንቍውን ሁሉ፥ በቤተ መዛግብቱም የተገኘውን ሁሉ አሳያቸው፤ በቤቱና በግዛቱ ሁሉ ካለው ሕዝቅያስ ያላሳያቸው የለም።
ነቢዩም ኢሳይያስ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ መጥቶ፥ “እነዚህ ሰዎች ምን አሉ? ከወዴትስ መጡ?” አለው። ሕዝቅያስም፥ “ከሩቅ ሀገር ከባቢሎን መጡ” አለው።
ኢሳይያስም፥ “በቤትህ ያዩት ምንድን ነው?” አለው፤ ሕዝቅያስም፥ “በቤቴ ያለውን ሁሉ አይተዋል፤ በቤቴ፥ እንዲሁም በቤተ መዛግብቴ ካለው ያላሳየኋቸው የለም” አለው።
ኢሳይያስም ሕዝቅያስን፥ “የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ።
እነሆ፥ በቤትህ ያለው ሁሉ፥ አባቶችህም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ያከማቹት ሁሉ ወደ ባቢሎን የሚፈልስበት ወራት ይመጣል፤ ምንም አያስቀሩልህም፤ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
ከአንተ ከሚወጡት ከምትወልዳቸው ልጆችህ ማርከው ይወስዳሉ፤ በባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ቤት ውስጥ ጃንደረቦችና የቤት አሽከሮች ይሆናሉ” አለው።
ሕዝቅያስም ኢሳይያስን፥ “እርሱ የተናገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል መልካም ነው፤ ነገር ግን፦ በዘመኔ ሰላምና ጽድቅ ይሁን” አለው።

sections.title: A promise that was spoken concerning the people of Israel.

verses.text: "Be comforted; comfort my people," saith the Lord.

"O priests, speak concerning Jerusalem and the things that pertain to her heart; for her fall hath come as a result of her transgression, and her iniquity hath been taken away; for the hand of the Lord hath received her in all her transgressions, as if she had received double for all her sins."
"The voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Prepare the way of the Lord; make straight in the desert a highway for our God.'"
"Let every valley be exalted, and every mountain and hill be made low; and let the crooked be made straight, and the rough places plain."
"And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it."
"A man saith, 'Cry out!' and I said, 'What shall I cry?' 'All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field.'"
"The grass withereth, the flower fadeth; but the word of our God shall stand forever."
"The grass withereth, the flower fadeth; but the word of our God shall endure forever."

"O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, 'Behold your God!'"
"Behold, the Lord God will come with strong hand, and His arm shall rule for Him; behold, His reward is with Him, and His work before Him."
The chariot doth make a sound like unto a horse; it doth carry its burdens upon its shoulders, and it leadeth those who are laden with care.

Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with a span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
Who hath known the mind of the Lord, or who hath been his counselor?
Or who hath been his equal? Or who hath instructed him? Who hath taught him judgment? And who hath shown him the way of understanding?
Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance; behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
To whom then will ye liken God? Or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains. Will ye liken unto him?
The workman chooseth a graven image that shall not be moved; and he seeketh for a cunning workman to prepare a likeness that shall not be shaken.
አላወቃችሁምን? ወይስ አልሰማችሁምን? ከጥንትስ አልተወራላችሁምን? ወይስ ምድር ከተመሠረተች ጀምሮ አላስተዋላችሁምን?
እርሱ የምድርን ክበብ ያጸናል፤ በእርስዋም የሚኖሩት እንደ አንበጣ ናቸው፤ ሰማያትን እንደ መጋረጃ የሚዘረጋቸው፥ እንደ ድንኳንም ለመኖሪያ የሚዘረጋቸው፤
አለቆችንም የሚገዛላቸው እንዳይኖር የሚያደርግ ምድርንም እንደ ኢምንት የሚያደርጋት እርሱ ነው።
በእርሱም ላይ ዛፉንና ሣሩን፥ የማይቈጠር ሌላውንም ብዙ ፍጥረት የፈጠረ እርሱ ነው። ነፋስም በነፈሰባቸው ጊዜ ይደርቃሉ፤ ዐውሎ ነፋስም እንደ ገለባ ይጠርጋቸዋል።
እንግዲህ እተካከለው ዘንድ በማን መሰላችሁኝ? ይላል ቅዱሱ እግዚአብሔር።
ዐይናችሁን ወደ ሰማይ አንሥታችሁ ተመልከቱ፤ ይህን ሁሉ የፈጠረ ማን ነው? ከዋክብትንም በሙሉ የሚቈጥራቸው እርሱ ነው፤ በየጊዜያቸው ያመጣቸዋል፤ ሁሉንም በየስማቸው ይጠራቸዋል፤ በክብሩ ብዛትና በችሎቱ ብርታት አንድስ እንኳ አይታጣውም።
ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ እስራኤልም ሆይ፥ መንገዴ ከእግዚአብሔር ተሰውራለች፤ አምላኬም ከእኔ ርቋል፤ ፍርዴንም ትትዋል፤ ለምን ትላለህ? ለምንስ እንዲህ ትናገራለህ?
አሁንም አላወቅህምን? አልሰማህምን? እግዚአብሔር የዘለዓለም አምላክ፥ የምድርንም ዳርቻ የፈጠረ አምላክ ነው፤ አይራብም፤ አይጠማም፤ አይደክምም፤ ማስተዋሉም አይመረመርም።
ለደካሞች ኀይልን ይሰጣል፤ መከራ የሚቀበሉትንም አያሳዝናቸውም።
ብላቴኖች ይራባሉ፤ ጐልማሶች ይታክታሉ፤ ጐበዛዝቱም ፈጽሞ ይዝላሉ።
Those who put their hope in the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings like eagles; they shall run and not be weary; they shall walk and not faint.

sections.title: The covenant given to Israel.

verses.text: O ye islands, return unto me; for your rulers shall strengthen themselves, and in unity they shall declare judgment.

Who hath raised up righteousness from the east? He calleth unto Him, and who is this that cometh? Before nations and kings, He bringeth forth our cause. Their swords shall be cast down to the earth; their bows shall be broken asunder.
He shall lead them; their feet shall walk in the way of peace.
Who is it that hath wrought this and performed it, calling forth generations from the beginning? I, the Lord, am the First and the Last; I am He.
Fear not, O ye nations; the rulers of the earth have drawn near; they have gathered in unity; they have come.
Every man shall help his neighbor; every one shall assist his brother; and to his brother he shall say, "Be strong."

And the craftsman shall strengthen the smith, and he that smiteth with the hammer shall encourage him that smote; concerning the work of the potter, he shall say, "It is good"; and he shall not be moved by the shaking of the hammer.
My servant is Israel, whom I have chosen, the seed of Jacob, whom I love, the offspring of Abraham.
Thou art he whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called from the corners thereof; thou art my servant; I have chosen thee; I will not cast thee away; fear not, for I am with thee.
For I am with thee; be not afraid; for I am thy God; be not dismayed; I will strengthen thee; I will help thee; I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
እነሆ፥ የሚቃወሙህ ሁሉ ያፍራሉ፤ ይዋረዱማል፤ እንዳልነበሩም ይሆናሉ፤ ጠላቶችህም ይጠፋሉ።
የሚያሠቃዩህንም ሰዎች ትሻቸዋለህ፤ አታገኛቸውምም፤ እንዳልነበሩ ይሆናሉና፤ የሚዋጋህም የለም።
ቀኝ እጅህን የያዝሁህ፥ እንዲህም የምልህ እኔ አምላክህ ነኝና።
ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፤ በቍጥር ጥቂት የነበርህ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እኔ እረዳሃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ የሚቤዥህም የእስራኤል ቅዱስ ነው።
እነሆ፥ እንደ ተሳለች እንደ አዲስ ባለ ጥርስ ማሄጃ አድርጌሃለሁ፤ ተራሮችንም ታሄዳለህ፤ ኮረብቶችንም ታደቅቃቸዋለህ እንደ ገለባም ታደርጋቸዋለህ።
ታበጥራቸዋለህ፤ ነፋስም ይጠርጋቸዋል፤ ዐውሎ ነፋስም ይበትናቸዋል፤ አንተም በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ደስ ይልሃል።
ድሆችና ምስኪኖች ውኃ ይሻሉ፤ አያገኙምም፤ ምላሳቸውም በጥማት ደርቋል፤ እኔ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እሰማቸዋለሁ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እኔ አልተዋቸውም።
በተራሮች ላይ ወንዞችን፥ በሸለቆችም መካከል ምንጮችን እከፍታለሁ፤ ምድረ በዳውን ለውኃ መቆሚያ፥ የተጠማችውንም ምድር ለውኃ መፍለቂያ አደርጋለሁ።
በምድረ በዳ ዝግባውንና ግራሩን፥ ባርሰነቱንና የዘይቱን ዛፍ አበቅላለሁ፤
ይኸውም የእግዚአብሔር እጅ ይህን ሁሉ እንደ ሠራ፥ የእስራኤልም ቅዱስ ይህን እንደ አሳየ ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ ያስተውሉም ዘንድ፥ ይረዱም ዘንድ፥ ያምኑም ዘንድ ነው።
Your judgment has drawn near, saith the Lord God; your counsel also has come near, saith the King of Jacob.

Let them come; let them declare unto us what shall befall you; let us also prepare our hearts, that we may know their end, and let them tell us what the former things were, that we may understand what they are; and let them show us what is to come.
That ye may know that ye are gods, declare ye the things that are to come after; and let us be astonished, that we may see in unity, whether ye do good or evil.
Whence are ye? From whence have ye come? Are ye not chosen from the earth?
I have stirred up those that come from the north and from the rising of the sun; they shall call upon my name; let the rulers come forth; as a potter shapes clay, so shall they be shaped.

Let us know, therefore, what was spoken of old: Is it truth that we speak, and who spoke it before? There is none that speaks before it comes to pass; there is none that reveals it; there is none that hears your words.
In the beginning, for Zion's sake, I will not hold my peace; and for Jerusalem's sake, I will not rest, until her righteousness go forth as brightness, and her salvation as a lamp that burneth.
There is none that speaks of their gods, and when I ask them from whence they are, they will not answer me.
Their works are in vain; they shall labor in vain.

sections.title: The Lord is the Master.

verses.text: እነሆ፥ ደግፌ የያዝሁት ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ፤ ነፍሴ የተቀበለችው ምርጤ እስራኤልም፤ በእርሱ ላይ መንፈሴን አድርጌአለሁ፤ እርሱም ለአሕዛብ ፍርድን ያመጣል።
አይጮኽም፤ ቃሉንም አያነሣም፤ ድምፁንም በሜዳ አያሰማም።
የተቀጠቀጠ ሸንበቆን አይሰብርም፤ የሚጤስንም ክር አያጠፋም፤ ነገር ግን በእውነት ፍርድን ያመጣል።
በምድርም ፍርድን እስኪያደርግ ድረስ ያበራል እንጂ አይጠፋም፤ አሕዛብም በስሙ ይታመናሉ።
ሰማይን የፈጠረ፥ የዘረጋውም፥ ምድርንና በውስጥዋ ያለውን ሁሉ ያጸና፥ በእርስዋ ላይ ለሚኖሩ ሕዝብ እስትንፋስን፥ ለሚሄዱባትም መንፈስን የሚሰጥ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦
“እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ በጽድቅ ጠርቼሃለሁ፤ በእጄም እይዝሃለሁ፤ አበረታሃለሁም፤ ለልጅ ልጅ ቃል ኪዳን፥ ለአሕዛብም ብርሃን አድርጌ እሰጥሃለሁ።
የዕውራንንም ዐይን ትከፍት ዘንድ፥ የተጋዙትንም ከግዞት ቤት፥ በጨለማም የተቀመጡትን ከወህኒ ቤት ታወጣ ዘንድ።
እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ነኝ፤ ስሜ ይህ ነው፤ ክብሬን ለሌላ፥ ምስጋናዬንም ለተቀረጹ ምስሎች አልሰጥም።
እነሆ የቀድሞው ነገር ተፈጸመ፤ አዲስ ነገርንም እናገራለሁ፤ አስቀድሞም ሳይነገር እርሱን አስታውቃችኋለሁ።”
ወደ ባሕር የምትወርዱ፥ በእርስዋም ውስጥ የምትጓዙ ሁሉ፥ ደሴቶችና በእነርሱም ላይ የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር አዲስ መዝሙር ዘምሩ፤ ከምድርም ዳርቻ ስሙን አክብሩ።
The wilderness and its cities, the inhabitants and dwellings of Kedar, let their voices be heard; let those who dwell in the cliffs lift their voices; let them cry out from the tops of the mountains.
Give glory to the Lord; let His praise be proclaimed in the islands.
The Lord God of hosts shall go forth; He shall destroy the mighty; He shall raise up righteousness; He shall shout with strength against His enemies.
From ancient times I have been silent; now shall I be silent forever? Now I shall be as a woman in labor; I shall groan; I shall be united in my anguish.
I shall make desolate the mountains and the hills; I shall destroy all their vegetation; I shall make the rivers into islands; I shall dry up the pools.

I shall lead the blind in a way they know not; I shall make their paths crooked; I shall set darkness before them as light; I shall make the rough places smooth. These things I shall do for them; I shall not forsake them.
Those who trust in the images that are carved, who say of the things they have made, "You are our gods," shall turn back in shame; they shall be utterly terrified.
Hearken, you blind ones; you are also deaf; look and see.
Who is blind but My servant? Who is deaf as My messenger whom I send? Let the servants of the Lord be called.
You see many things, but do not observe; your ears are open, but you do not hear.
እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ምስጋናውን ያጸድቅና ከፍ ያደርግ ዘንድ መከረ።
እነሆ፥ ተመለከትሁ፤ ሕዝቡ የተበዘበዘና የተዘረፈ ነው፤ ወጥመድ በሁሉም ቦታ በዋሻዎችና እነርሱን በሸሸጉባቸው ቤቶች ተጠምዶአል፤ ብዝበዛ ሆነዋል፤ የሚያድንም የለም፤ ምርኮም ሆነዋል፤ የሚያስጥላቸውም የለም።
ከመካከላችሁ ይህን የሚያደምጥ፥ ለሚመጣውም ጊዜ የሚሰማ ማን ነው?
ያዕቆብን እንዲማርኩት፥ እስራኤልንም እንዲበዘብዙት ያደረገ ማን ነው? እነርሱም የበደሉት፥ በመንገዱም ይሄዱ ዘንድ ያልወደዱት፥ ሕጉንም ያልሰሙት እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አይደለምን?
ስለዚህ የቍጣውን መዓትና የሰልፉን ጽናት አመጣባቸው፤ በዙሪያቸው አቃጠላቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን አላወቁም፤ በልባቸውም አላስተዋሉም።
Now, Jacob, thus saith the Lord who created thee, O Israel, “Fear not, for I have redeemed thee; I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.”

When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee; when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
I am the Holy One of Israel, thy God, thy Savior; I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honorable, and I have loved thee; therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
Fear not, for I am with thee; I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west.
Bring my sons from afar, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
Everyone that is called by my name, for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
The people that have eyes, yet see not; and ears, yet hear not, I have brought forth.

All nations gathered together, and the people assembled; who among them can declare this? And who can show us former things? Let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear, and say, It is truth.

Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen; that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
እኔ፥ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ ከእኔ ሌላ የሚያድን አምላክ የለም።
ተናግሬአለሁ፤ አድኜማለሁ፤ መክሬማለሁ፤ በእናንተም ዘንድ ባዕድ አምልኮ አልነበረም፤ ስለዚህ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ እንደ ሆንሁ እናንተ ራሳችሁ ምስክሮች ናችሁ፤
ከጥንት ጀምሮ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ ከእጄም የሚያመልጥ የለም፤ እሠራለሁ፤ ወደ ኋላስ የሚመልስ ማን ነው?
የእስራኤል ቅዱስ፥ የሚቤዣችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “ስለ እናንተ ወደ ባቢሎን ሰድጃለሁ፤ ስደተኞችን አስነሣለሁ፤ ከለዳውያንም በመርከብ ውስጥ ይታሰራሉ።
ቅዱሳችሁ፥ የእስራኤል ፈጣሪ፥ ንጉሣችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ እኔ ነኝ።”
በባሕር ውስጥ መንገድን በኀይለኛም ውኃ ውስጥ መተላለፊያን ያደረገ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ እንዲህ ይላል፦
እግዚአብሔር ሰረገላውንና ፈረሱን ሠራዊቱንና አርበኛውን ያወጣል፤ እነርሱ ግን በአንድነት ተኝተዋል፤ አይነሡም፤ ቀርተዋል፤ እንደ ጥዋፍ ኩስታሪም ጠፍተዋል፤
የፊተኛውን ነገር አታስታውሱ፤ የጥንቱንም ነገር አታስቡ።
እነሆ፥ አዲስ ነገርን አደርጋለሁ፤ እርሱም አሁን ይበቅላል፤ እናንተም አታውቁትም፤ በምድረ በዳም መንገድን፥ በበረሃም ወንዞችን አደርጋለሁ።
የምድረ በዳ አራዊት፥ ቀበሮችና ሰጎኖች፥ ያከብሩኛል። የመረጥሁትን ሕዝቤን አጠጣ ዘንድ በምድረ በዳ ውኃን፥ በበረሃም ወንዞችን ሰጥቻለሁና፤
They are the people whom I have created to declare my praise;
O Jacob, behold, I have not called you; O Israel, I have not wearied you;

For the offerings of the burnt sacrifices, you have not brought me your sheep; and in the offerings of your sacrifices, you have not honored me; neither have you troubled yourself with the fat of your offerings; nor have you offered me incense.
Nor have you bought me sweet cane with money; neither have I desired the fat of your sacrifices; but in your sins and in your wickedness, you have made me to be weary.
As for your transgressions, I do not remember them, for I am he who speaks concerning myself.
Remember me; let us walk together in unity; that you may be justified, speak concerning your wickedness.
In the beginning, your fathers, and afterward your leaders, have transgressed.
The leaders have forsaken my sanctuary; therefore, I have given Jacob to destruction, and Israel to reproach.

sections.title: There is no other god besides the Lord God.

verses.text: Now, my servant Jacob, whom I have chosen, O Israel, hear Me.
The Lord God, who created you and formed you from the womb, says this: “Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name, you are Mine, O Jacob, whom I have chosen, O Israel.”
I will give water to the thirsty land and streams in the dry ground; I will pour My Spirit upon your descendants, and My blessing upon your offspring;
They shall spring up among the grass like willows by the watercourses.
This: “I am the Lord your God,” says He; that is called by the name of Jacob; this: “I am the Lord your God,” shall be inscribed by His hand; it shall be called by the name of Israel.”
The Lord God of Israel, the Redeemer of Israel, the Lord of hosts, says this: “I am the First, and I am the Last; besides Me there is no God.
Who is like Me? Let him proclaim it; let him declare and set it in order for Me, since I appointed the ancient people. Let them declare what is to come, and what will happen.
Do not fear, nor be afraid; have I not told you from that time, and declared it? You are My witnesses. Is there a God besides Me? Indeed, there is no other Rock; I know not one.”

sections.title: Concerning the vanity of idolatry.

verses.text: ጣዖታትን የሚቀርጹ ያንጊዜ አይኖሩም፤ የተቀረጸውን ምስል የሚሠሩም ሁሉ ከንቱዎች ናቸው፤ የማይረባቸውን የራሳቸውን ፍላጎት የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ያፍራሉ።
ጣዖታትን የሚሠሩ፥ የማይጠቅማቸውን ምስል የሚቀርጹና በእነርሱም የተሠሩ ሁሉ ይደርቃሉ።
ከሰዎች መካከል ደንቆሮዎች ሁሉ ይሰብሰቡ፤ በአንድነትም ይቁሙ፤ በአንድነትም ያፍራሉ፤ ይዋረዳሉም።
ብረት ሠሪ መጥረቢያውን ይስላል፤ ጣዖቱን በመጥረቢያ ይቀርጸዋል፤ በመዶሻም መትቶ ቅርጽ ይሰጠዋል፤ በክንዱም ኀይል ይሠራዋል፤ እርሱም ይራባል፤ ይደክምማል፤ ውኃም አይጠጣም።
ጠራቢውም እንጨት ቈርጦ በልኩ ያቆመዋል፤ በማጣበቂያም ያያይዘዋል፤ በሰው አምሳልና በሰው ውበት ያስመስለዋል፤ በቤትም ውስጥ ያቆመዋል።
እግዚአብሔር ያበቀለውን፥ በዝናምም ያሳደገውን ዛፍ ከዱር ይቈርጣል።
ለሰውም ማገዶ ይሆናል፤ ከእርሱም ወስዶ ይሞቃል፤ አንድዶም እንጀራ ይጋግርበታል፤ ከእርሱም የተረፈውን ጣዖታትን አበጅቶ ይሰግድላቸዋል።
ግማሹን በእሳት ያቃጥላል፤ በዚያም በግማሹ ሥጋ ይጠብሳል፤ ጥብሱንም ይበላና ይጠግባል፤ ይሞቃልና፥ “እሰይ ሞቅሁ፥ እሳቱን አይቻለሁ” ይላል።
የቀረውንም እንጨት ጣዖት አድርጎ ምስል ይቀርጽበታል፤ በፊቱም ተጐንብሶ ይሰግዳል፤ ወደ እርሱም እየጸለየ፥ “አምላኬ ነህና አድነኝ” ይላል።
አያውቁም፤ አያስቡም፤ እንዳያዩ ዐይኖቻቸው፥ እንዳያስተውሉም ልቦቻቸው ተጋርደዋል።

Let no one in his heart say, "I shall consume half of it with fire; I shall bake bread upon its coals; I shall roast flesh and eat it; shall I not do what is left over? Shall I not offer it to the tree? For there is neither knowledge nor understanding."

Thus, their hearts have become hardened as stone, and like those who are wicked, there is none among them who can save his soul; let it be known that "there is no falsehood in my right hand." Behold, let this be observed.

sections.title: The mercy of the Lord.

verses.text: O Jacob, thou art my servant; Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten. I have created thee; thou art my servant; O Israel, fear not.
I will blot out thy transgressions as a cloud, and thy sins as a thick mist; return unto me, for I have redeemed thee.

The Lord hath shown mercy upon Israel; let the heavens rejoice over them; for the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified Himself in Israel; let the foundations of the earth break forth into joy; let the mountains and the hills rejoice with all the trees of the field.
Thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel: “Fear not, for I have redeemed thee; I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.”
Who is he that saith, “We shall rise from the dead,” and speaks deceit from his heart? The wise shall turn back; their counsel shall be brought to naught.

The word of the servant shall be fulfilled; the counsel of the messengers shall be accomplished. Concerning Jerusalem: “Thou shalt be called the habitation of man; and the cities of Judah shall be restored; and the wilderness shall be made fruitful,” thus saith the Lord.
And concerning her, it is said, “Let the dry places rejoice, and let thy fountains be filled.”

Concerning Cyrus, it is said, “Be wise; for he shall say concerning Jerusalem: ‘Thou shalt be built, and concerning the temple: I will lay the foundation thereof,’ and all my pleasure shall be accomplished.”

sections.title: The Lord hath chosen Cyrus for kingship.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ለቀባሁት፥ አሕዛብንም በፊቱ አስገዛ ዘንድ የነገሥታትንም ኀይል እጥል ዘንድ፥ በሮቹም እንዳይዘጉ መዝጊያዎቹን በፊቱ እከፍት ዘንድ፥ ቀኝ እጁን ለያዝሁት ለቂሮስ እንዲህ ይላል፦
“በፊትህ እሄዳለሁ፤ ተራሮችንም ዝቅ አደርጋለሁ፤ የናሱንም ደጆች እሰብራለሁ፤ የብረቱንም መወርወሪያዎች እቈርጣለሁ፤
በስምህም የምጠራህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቅ ዘንድ በጨለማ የነበሩትን መዛግብት እሰጥሃለሁ፤ የማይታየውንም የተደበቀውን ሀብት እገልጥልሃለሁ።
ስለ አገልጋዬ ስለ ያዕቆብ፥ ስለ መረጥሁትም ስለ እስራኤል ብዬ በስምህ ጠርቼሃለሁ፤ ተቀበልሁህም፤ አንተ ግን አላወቅኸኝም።
እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ነኝ፤ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ አምላክ የለም፤ አጸናሁህ፤ አንተ ግን አላወቅኸኝም።
በፀሐይ መውጫና በምዕራብ ያሉ ከእኔ በቀር ሌላ አምላክ እንደሌለ ያውቁ ዘንድ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ነኝ፤ ከእኔም ሌላ አምላክ የለም።
ብርሃንን ፈጠርሁ፤ ጨለማውንም ፈጠርሁ፤ ሰላምንም አደርጋለሁ፤ ክፋትንም አመጣለሁ፤ እነዚህን ሁሉ ያደረግሁ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ።
“ሰማይ በላይ ደስ ይበለው፤ ደመናትም ጽድቅን ያዝንቡ፤ ምድርም መድኀኒትን ታብቅል፤ ጽድቅም በአንድነት ይብቀል፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ፈጥሬሃለሁ።
“እንደ ሸክላ ሠሪ ሥራ ውብ አድርጌ ሠራሁህ፤ ምድርን የሚያርስ ሁልጊዜ ያርሳልን? ጭቃ ሠሪውን፦ ምን ትሠራለህ? እጅ የለህምና መሥራት አትችልም ይለዋልን? ጭቃ ሠሪውን ይከራከረዋልን?
አባቱን፦ ለምን ወለድኸኝ? እናቱንም፦ ለምን አምጠሽ ወለድሽኝ? ለሚል ወዮ!
"And the Holy One of Israel, the Creator, saith thus: 'Ask of me concerning the sons and daughters; concerning the work of my hand, command ye me.'
"I have made the earth; I have created man upon it; I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded."
"I have raised up Cyrus in righteousness; and I will direct all his ways; he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the Lord of hosts."

"Thus saith the Lord of hosts: 'Egypt and the merchandise of Ethiopia shall come unto thee; the tall ones shall pass over unto thee; for thee they shall be brought; their hands shall be upon thy head, and they shall come over to thee; for thee they shall bow down, saying: 'Surely, God is with thee; there is no other God.'"
"Thou art the Lord; I know not another God besides thee, O God of Israel, my Savior."
"All who are incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded; they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish."
"O ye islands, listen unto me; the Lord hath redeemed Israel with an everlasting Redeemer; and ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end."
"He who created the heavens, the Lord; he who formed the earth and made it, he hath established it; he created it not in vain, but formed it to be inhabited: 'I am the Lord; and there is none else.'"
"I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth; I said not unto the seed of Jacob, 'Seek ye me in vain'; I, the Lord, speak righteousness; I declare things that are right."

"Ye are of the seed of Abraham, and ye are called; gather yourselves together, and be united; for the one who is cast off is like the wood of the image, and the knowledge of the God who cannot save is not with you."

If there be any who speak, let them know from ancient times who has borne this witness. Let them be silent, for I have shown and spoken, "Am I not the Lord God? Besides Me, there is no other god; I am the righteous God and the Savior; there is none like Me."
All ye who dwell in the land, for I am God, and besides Me there is no other; return unto Me, and ye shall be saved.
My word shall go forth from My mouth in righteousness; it shall not return unto Me void; all flesh shall be blessed in Me; thus I say within Myself.
Glory and righteousness shall come unto Him; all who oppose the Lord shall be afraid.
The children of Israel, all of them, shall be justified before the Lord; they shall be honored and called blessed.

sections.title: The angel of Babylon

verses.text: Bel fell down; Dagon was shattered; their images became like a heap of dung; both beast and man shall be cast away; for they are like a broken pot, and they shall not rise again.
They are weak; they have no strength; they could not save themselves from war; yet they have become like the dust.
O house of Jacob, ye who are called by the name of Israel, all ye who are borne by me from the womb, and carried from the time of your birth, hear me.
Until the end I am He; even unto the last I am He; I will guide you; I have served you; I also will forgive; I also will sustain you; I also will deliver you.
To whom will you liken me? All ye who err, consider this; be wise.

They who bring forth gold and silver from the earth, and weigh it in the balance, they shall be like the worthless; and he shall make an idol, and it shall be a vain thing; for they shall be confounded.

They shall carry their burdens upon their shoulders; and in their place they shall stand; they shall not depart from their place; and if one cries unto them, they shall not hear; neither shall they deliver from evil.
Consider this and do not forget; O ye who have erred, return to righteousness; and let your hearts be restored.
I am God; there is none other beside me; consider the former things and the ancient things. I am the Lord; there is none like me.
In the beginning I declare the end; even that which was not done from ancient times I will speak; for my counsel shall stand; all that I have purposed I will accomplish.
From the east and from a distant land, I shall call upon you for counsel; I have spoken, I have brought forth, I have created, I have done, I have brought forth, and I have prepared the way for you.
O you who are far removed from righteousness, hear me;
I have brought forth my righteousness; I have not withheld the Savior who is found in me; for the glory of Zion, I have given the Savior to Israel.

sections.title: The Fall of Babylon

verses.text: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed, blessed is he that shall be unto thee, for thou shalt no longer be called the lady of kingdoms; thou shalt sit upon the ground, and thou shalt be as one without a throne.
And thou shalt grind meal, and thou shalt be uncovered; thy nakedness shall be seen, and thy shame shall be revealed; and thou shalt be as a fugitive.
Thy shame shall be made manifest; thy downfall shall be seen; righteousness shall be far from thee; and thus, in thee, I shall not deliver a man unto destruction.
Thy Redeemer is strong; the Lord of hosts is His name; He is the Holy One of Israel.
O daughter of the Chaldeans, after this, thou shalt no longer be called the “mother of kingdoms,” and thou shalt sit in silence, and enter into darkness.
I was in distress upon my people; thou didst oppress my heritage; with thine own hand, thou didst deliver them; for thy daughters, thou didst not spare; and their glory, thou didst greatly dishonor.
And thou didst say, “I shall be a queen forever,” yet this didst thou not consider in thy heart; neither didst thou remember the latter end of it.
Now, thou dost sit in pride, and in thy heart dost say, “I am, and there is none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, nor shall I know the loss of children,” yet this shall be thy fate.

Yet now, in one day, shall these two things come upon thee; the loss of children and widowhood shall come upon thee suddenly, for the multitude of thy sorceries and the great abundance of thine enchantments.
In thy wickedness, thou dost trust; yet thou sayest, “I am, and there is none else beside me,” and in thy heart, thou dost consider not; for thou dost say, “I am, and there is none else beside me.”

Therefore, destruction shall come upon thee; thou shalt not know thy calamity; within thee, thou shalt be brought low; calamity shall come upon thee; thou shalt not be able to escape; death shall come upon thee suddenly; thou shalt not know it.
Perhaps it may be that he can help thee, as he is, from thy adversaries and from thy childhood, arise with the multitude of thy oppressors.

By thy wicked counsel, thou hast been brought low; now, those who dwell in the heavens shall be shaken, and those who regard the stars shall be troubled; let them help thee; let them declare unto thee what shall come upon thee.
Behold, all shall be consumed as by a fierce fire; their bodies shall not be able to withstand the power of the flame; they shall be as stubble, and upon them thou shalt sit.
They shall be thy helpers; from thy childhood, thou hast been weary; a man shall be troubled in himself; but for thee, there is no healer.

sections.title: The Lord, who has created all things and knows all things, for He is.

verses.text: Behold, you who are called by the name of Israel, and who have come forth from Judah, not in truth nor in righteousness, calling upon Him, the God of Israel, in the name of the Lord, O house of Jacob, hear this!
You are called by the name of the holy city, and your name is known as the Lord God of hosts, who is called in Israel, hear this!
I have spoken of the former things from ancient times; they have gone forth from my mouth, and I have proclaimed them; they have come to pass.
Thou art a vessel of iron, and thy foundation is as a strong fortress; I have known it.
Therefore, do not say, "This is what I have done; this is what I have commanded," before it comes to pass; I have declared it to you.
You have heard all things; I have not known you; from this day forth, I will declare to you new things.
They have not been created from ancient times; and you, do not say, "Behold, I will declare them," for I have not heard them before this day.
I have not known you; I have not perceived you; I have not opened your ears from ancient times; you have been called a transgressor from the womb.
I will show you my anger for my name's sake; and lest I consume you, I will bring forth my glory upon you.
Behold, I have delivered you; yet it is not with silver; I have brought you forth from affliction.
Concerning me, concerning myself, I shall do this for you; my name has been exalted; and my glory I shall not give to another.
O Jacob, whom I have called, O Israel, hear me; I am the first, and I am the everlasting.
My hand has laid the foundation of the earth; my right hand has stretched out the heavens; I call to them, and together they stand.
All are gathered together in unity; who has declared this? I have made your decree upon Babylon, to put away the seed of the Chaldeans by loving you.
I myself have spoken; I have called; I have brought forth; and my way shall be established.
Come unto me; hear this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time it was, I was there; and now the Lord God and His Spirit have sent me.
Your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, thus says: "I am the Lord your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you in the way you should go."
If you hearken to my commandments, then shall your peace be as a river, and your righteousness as the waves of the sea.
Your seed shall be as the sand, and your offspring as the dust of the earth; now your name shall not be cut off from before me, nor be destroyed.
Go forth from Babylon; flee from the Chaldeans; with a voice of singing declare this; let it be heard; even to the ends of the earth, say, "The Lord has redeemed His servant Jacob."

In the wilderness of the desert, at the time of their thirst, water would flow forth from the depths of the earth; and the earth was cleft asunder, and the water would gush forth for them; and my people would drink.
Thus saith the Lord God, "The wicked shall not find joy."

sections.title: Israel, the light of the nations.

verses.text: ደሴቶች ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ እናንተም አሕዛብ፥ አድምጡ፤ ከረዥም ዘመን በኋላ እንዲህ ይሆናል ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከእናቴም ሆድ ጀምሮ ስሜን ጠርቶአል፤
አፌንም እንደ ተሳለ ሰይፍ አድርጎአል፤ በእጁ ጥላ ሰውሮኛል፤ እንደ ተሳለ ፍላጻም አድርጎኛል፤ በሰገባው ውስጥም ሸሽጎኛል።
እርሱም፥ “እስራኤል ሆይ፥ አንተ ባርያዬ ነህ፤ በአንተም እከበራለሁ” አለኝ።
እኔ ግን፥ “በከንቱ ደከምሁ፤ ምንም ጥቅም ለሌለውና ለከንቱ ጕልበቴን ፈጀሁ፤ ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር ይፈርድልኛል፤ መከራዬም በአምላኬ ፊት ነው” አልሁ።
አሁንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ከብሬአለሁና፥ አምላኬም ጕልበት ሆኖኛልና ያዕቆብን ወደ እርሱ እንድመልስ፥ እስራኤልንም ወደ እርሱ እንድሰበስብ ባርያ እሆነው ዘንድ ከማኅፀን ጀምሮ የፈጠረኝ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።
እርሱም፥ “የያዕቆብን ነገዶች እንደገና እንድታስነሣ፥ ከእስራኤልም የተበተኑትን ወደ አባቶች ቃል ኪዳን እንድትመልስ ባርያዬ ትሆን ዘንድ ለአንተ እጅግ ታላቅ ነገር ነውና፥ እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ መድኀኒት ትሆን ዘንድ ለአሕዛብ ብርሃን አድርጌሃለሁ” ይላል።
ታዳጊህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “ሕይወቱን የሚያስጨንቃትን፥ በአሕዛብ የተጠላውን የአለቆችን ባርያ ቀድሱት፤ ነገሥታት ያዩታል፤ አለቆችም ስለ እግዚአብሔር ብለው ተነሥተው ይሰግዱለታል፤ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ ታማኝ ነውና፥ እኔም መርጨሃለሁና።”

sections.title: The people of Israel returned unto Jerusalem.

verses.text: Thus saith the Lord, “On the chosen day I have heard thee; on the day when affliction is made, I have delivered thee; I have made a covenant and given it unto the people; and the land shall be restored, that thou mayest inherit the precious heritage.”

“Let those who are in captivity go forth; and those who have sat in darkness, let them be revealed; for it is great.” They shall be heard upon all the paths; their herald shall be upon every street corner.
For those who are led astray shall be comforted, and they shall be guided beside the waters of springs; they shall not thirst; they shall not be weary; neither shall the heat of the sun harm them.
I will make a way through all the mountains; and all the paths shall be for gathering.
Behold, these come from afar; behold, these come from the north and from the west; and these from the land of the Persians.
The Lord hath had compassion upon His people, for He hath regarded their afflictions. O heavens, rejoice; and let the earth be glad; and let the mountains break forth into singing.
Yet Zion said, “The Lord hath forsaken me; and my Lord hath forgotten me.”
“Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Though she may forget, yet will I not forget thee.”
Behold, I have engraved thee upon the palms of My hands; thy walls are continually before Me.
After thy destruction, thou shalt hasten; they that have destroyed thee shall go forth from thee.

"Lift up your eyes round about, and behold; all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the Lord, thou shalt surely clothe them all as with an ornament, and like a bride shalt thou adorn thyself."
"For I have forsaken thee, and I have cast thee away; and for those who dwell with thee, today thou shalt be a desolation; and they that have forsaken thee shall flee from thee."
"Their children, who were once with thee, shall say unto thine ears: 'We have kept our place, and they shall say, 'This is the place where we shall dwell.'"
"And thou shalt say in thy heart: 'I have become as one who bears children, and who shall bear these? Who hath brought these up? Behold, I was left alone; wherefore then hath these come from?'"

"Thus saith the Lord God: 'Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and set my standard to the people; and thy sons shall come from afar, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.'"

"And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers; they shall bow down to thee with their faces toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord; for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me."
"Is it possible to dwell in the shadow of the Almighty? Shall we be delivered from the oppression of the wicked?"
"But the Lord saith, 'Those who are mighty shall be taken away; and the multitude of the terrible shall be delivered; I will judge thy cause, and I will deliver thy children.'"
"They shall eat the flesh of thy mighty ones; as a sweet wine, they shall drink their blood; for I am the Lord thy healer and thy deliverer, and I shall support the strength of Jacob."

Thus saith the Lord God, “Where is the letter of your mother that I have given you? Or to whom have I sold you for your transgressions? Behold, for your iniquities you have been sold; and for your wickedness your mother has been put away.”

Behold, I have come; yet there is no man; I have called, but there is none to answer; is my hand not strong enough to save? Or is there no power in me to deliver? Behold, at your cry I will dry up the sea; and I will make rivers into a wilderness; their fish shall die for lack of water; and they shall perish of thirst.
I will cover the heavens with darkness; and I will make sackcloth their covering.”

The Lord God hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary; he wakeneth morning by morning; he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
The Lord God hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious; neither turned away back.
I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair; I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
The Lord God is my help; therefore I shall not be confounded; therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? Let us stand together; who is mine adversary? Let him come near to me.
Behold, the Lord God will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? Behold, all ye shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat you up.
Who among you feareth the Lord, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? Let him trust in the name of the Lord, and stay upon his God.

Behold, the fire that consumes, and the flame that rises high, shall all of you be engulfed; walk in the light of your fire and in the flame that you have kindled. This shall be your lot from My hand; you shall lie down in torment.

sections.title: The Eternal Wealth of Jerusalem

verses.text: O ye who follow righteousness, and who seek the Lord, hear me; behold the strong world from which ye have been separated, and consider the deep pit from which ye have been hewn.
Look unto your father Abraham, and unto your mother Sarah; for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.

O Jerusalem, I will rejoice in thee; and in all thy desolations I will rejoice; for I will make thy wilderness as Eden, and thy desert as the garden of the Lord. Joy and gladness, faith and the voice of singing shall be found therein.
Hearken unto me, O my people; hearken unto me, O ye princes; for the law shall go forth from me, and my judgment shall be as a light unto the nations.
My righteousness shall soon come forth; my salvation shall be as a light; the nations shall trust in my arm; the isles shall wait for me in hope; they shall trust in my arm.

Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look down upon the earth; for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wear out like a garment; and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner; but my salvation shall be forever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
Ye who know judgment, and my law is in your heart, O people, hearken unto me; fear not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
As a garment shall they make haste to wear out, and as wool shall they be changed; but my righteousness shall be forever, and my salvation shall be to generation after generation.
O Jerusalem, arise; arise; strengthen the power of thy knees; for as in former times and as in the days of old, arise, O ancient people.
Hast thou not dried up the sea, and the great waters? And hast thou not made a way for the redeemed to pass through, that the great sea should not be a barrier unto thee?
እግዚአብሔርም የተቤዣቸው ይመለሳሉ፤ ወደ ጽዮንም በደስታና በሐሤት ይመጣሉ፤ የዘለዓለምም ክብር በራሳቸው ላይ ይሆናል፤ ደስታንና ተድላን ያገኛሉ፤ ኀዘንና ልቅሶም ይወገዳሉ።
እኔ ነኝ፤ የማጽናናሽ እኔ ነኝ፤ አንቺ እንግዲህ ዕወቂ፤ ማንን ፈራሽ? የሚሞተውን ሰው እንደ ሣርም የሚጠወልገውን የሰው ልጅ ነውን?
አንቺ ግን ሰማያትን የፈጠረውን፥ ምድርንም የመሠረታትን ፈጣሪሽን እግዚአብሔርን ረስተሻል፤ ያጠፋሽ ዘንድ ባዘጋጀ ጊዜ ከአስጨናቂው ቍጣ የተነሣ ሁልጊዜ ቀኑን ሁሉ ፈርተሻል፤ ይቈጣሽ ዘንድ መክሮአልና፤ አሁን የሚያስጨንቅሽ ቍጣው የት አለ?
ከዳንሽ በኋላ እንግዲህ አይኖርምና፥ አይዘገይምምና።
ባሕርን የማናውጥ፥ ሞገዱም እንዲተምም የማደርግ አማላክሽ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝና፥ ስሜም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።
ቃሌን በአፍሽ አደርጋለሁ፤ ሰማይን በዘረጋሁበትና ምድርን በመሠረትሁበት በእጄ ጥላ እጋርድሻለሁ፤ ጽዮንንም አንቺ ሕዝቤ ነሽ እላታለሁ።
ከእግዚአብሔር እጅ የቍጣውን ጽዋ የጠጣሽ ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ተነሺ፤ ተነሺ፤ ቁሚ፤ የሚያንገደግድሽን የቍጣውን ጽዋ ጠጥተሻልና፥ ጨልጠሽውማልና።
ከወለድሻቸው ልጆችሽ ሁሉ የሚያረጋጋሽ አጣሽ፤ ከአሳደግሻቸውም ልጆችሽ ሁሉ እጁን ሰጥቶ የሚያነሣሽ የለም።
አሁንም እነዚህ ሁለቱ ይጠብቁሻል፤ ማን ያስተዛዝንሻል? እነርሱም ጥፋትና ውድቀት ራብና ሰይፍ ናቸው፤ እንግዲህ የሚያጽናናሽ ማን ነው?
ልጆችሽ ዝለዋል፤ እንደ ጠወለገ ቅጠልም በየመንገዱ ዳር ወድቀዋል፤ በአምላክሽ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣና ተግሣጽ ተሞልተዋል።
Therefore, without wine or strong drink, thou shalt not be forsaken; this is my name;
To thy people, thy God, the Lord God saith, “Behold, I will take away the cup of thy trembling, even the cup of my fury from thy hand; thou shalt no longer drink it again.

And to the hands of those who have oppressed thee, and to those who have afflicted thee, I will return thy hand; and I will make thee strong, and I will lead thee to those who have wronged thee. On the earth, I shall establish thee; all the wayfarers shall be made straight before thee.

sections.title: The Lord hath established Jerusalem as a dwelling place.

verses.text: O Zion, arise, arise; O Zion, increase thy strength; thou, the holy city of Jerusalem, shalt no longer be called forsaken, nor shall the unclean pass through thee anymore; for I shall increase thy glory.
O Jerusalem, lift up thy voice; arise, take thy place; O daughter of Zion, loose the bonds of thy neck.
Thus saith the Lord God, “Ye were sold for naught; and without money shall ye be redeemed.”
The Lord God saith, “My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.”

“My people have been taken away for naught; and now what have I here?” saith the Lord. “Surely, ye shall cry out, and ye shall be heard; for my name is continually blasphemed among the nations because of you.”
“Therefore my people shall know my name; for in that day they shall know that I am he that doth speak; behold, it is I.”

How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace, that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation, that saith unto Zion, “Thy God reigneth!”
Behold, thy watchmen shall lift up their voice; with the voice together shall they sing; for they shall see eye to eye, when the Lord shall bring again Zion.
Let the waste places of Jerusalem break forth into joy; for the Lord hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.
The Lord hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.
O ye who bear the vessels of the Lord, awake! awake! depart from thence; touch not the unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the Lord.
For the Lord shall go before you, and the God of Israel shall be your rear guard; therefore go not in haste, neither by flight shall ye go.

sections.title: He who receives affliction is a servant.

verses.text: Behold, my servant shall be exalted; he shall be lifted up, and shall be very high; and he shall greatly rejoice.
His visage shall be more marred than any man, and his form more than the sons of men; thus shall many nations marvel at him, for kings shall shut their mouths at him;
Many nations shall marvel at him; kings shall shut their mouths because of him; for that which had not been told them shall they see, and that which they had not heard shall they consider.
ጌታ ሆይ፥ ነገራችንን ማን ያምነናል? የእግዚአብሔርስ ክንድ ለማን ተገልጦአል?
ነገራችን በፊቱ እንደ ሕፃን፥ በደረቅ መሬትም እንዳለ ሥር ሆነ፤ መልክና ውበት የለውም፤ እነሆ፥ አየነው፤ ደም ግባት የለውም፤ ውበትም የለውም።
መልኩም የተናቀ፥ ከሰውም ልጆች ሁሉ የተዋረደ፥ የተገረፈ ሰው፥ መከራንም የተቀበለ ነው፤ ፊቱንም መልሶአልና አቃለሉት፥ አላከበሩትምም።
እርሱ ግን በእውነት ደዌያችንን ተቀበለ፤ ሕመማችንንም ተሸከመ፤ ስለ እኛም ታመመ፤ እኛም እንደ ታመመ፥ እንደ ተገረፈም ቈጠርነው።
እርሱ ግን ስለ ኀጢአታችን ቈሰለ፤ ስለ በደላችንም ታመመ፤ የሰላማችንም ተግሣጽ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ቍስል እኛ ተፈወስን።
እኛ ሁላችን እንደ በጎች ተቅበዝብዘን ጠፋን፤ ከእኛ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ገዛ መንገዱ አዘነበለ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ስለ ኀጢአታችን ለሞት አሳልፎ ሰጠው።
እርሱ ግን በመከራው ጊዜ አፉን አልከፈተም፤ እንደ በግ ወደ መታረድ ተነዳ፤ የበግ ጠቦትም በሸላቾቹ ፊት ዝም እንደሚል፥ እንዲሁ አፉን አልከፈተም።
በውርደቱ ፍርዱ ተወገደ፤ ሕይወቱ ከምድር ተወግዷልና ልደቱን ማን ይናገራል? ስለ ሕዝቤ ኀጢአት ለሞት ደረሰ።
ክፉዎችንም ስለ መቃብሩ፥ ባለጸጎችንም ስለ ሞቱ እሰጣለሁ፤ ኀጢአትን አላደረገምና፥ ከአፉም ሐሰት አልተገኘበትምና።
እግዚአብሔር ከግርፋቱ ያነጻው ዘንድ ፈቀደ፤ ስለ ኀጢአት መሥዋዕትን ብታቀርቡ ሰውነታችሁ ረዥም ዕድሜ ያለውን ዘር ታያለች።

And the Lord shall remove the sickness from his body; He shall show forth light; in wisdom shall He be distinguished; He shall deliver the righteous, who is bought for righteousness and good deeds. He shall bear the iniquities of many.

Therefore, He shall inherit many; He shall divide the spoil with the mighty; He has given His soul unto death, and He was numbered with the transgressors; yet He bore the iniquities of many and was given for their transgressions.

sections.title: The Lord hath loved Israel with an everlasting love.

verses.text: አንቺ ያልወለድሽ መካን ሆይ፥ ደስ ይበልሽ፤ አንቺ ያላማጥሽ ሆይ፥ እልል በዪ፤ ጩኺም፤ ባል ካላት ይልቅ ፈት የሆነቺቱ ልጆች በዝተዋልና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
የድንኳንሽን ስፍራ አስፊ፤ መጋረጃዎችሽንም ዘርጊ፤ አትቈጥቢ፤ አውታሮችሽን አስረዝሚ፤ ካስሞችሽንም ትከዪ።
እንደ ገናምበቀኝና በግራ ተስፋፊ፤ ዘርሽ አሕዛብን ይወርሳሉና፥ የፈረሱትንም ከተሞች መኖሪያ ታደርጊያለሽና።
አታፍሪምና አትፍሪ፤ አቷረጂምና አትደንግጪ፤ የዘለዓለም እፍረትሽንም ትረሺዋለሽ፤ የመበለትነትሽንም ስድብ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አታስቢም።
ፈጣሪሽ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የእስራኤልም አምላክ ታዳጊሽ ነው፤ እርሱም በምድር ሁሉ እንደዚሁ ይጠራል።
እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተተወችና እንደ ተበሳጨች፥ በልጅነቷም እንደ ተጠላች ሴት የጠራሽ አይደለም፥ ይላል አምላክሽ።
ጥቂት ጊዜ ተውሁሽ፤ በታላቅ ምሕረትም ይቅር እልሻለሁ።
በጥቂት ቍጣ ፊቴን ከአንቺ ሰወርሁ፤ በዘለዓለም ቸርነት ይቅር እልሻለሁ፥ ይላል ታዳጊሽ እግዚአብሔር።
ከኖኅ ዘመን ውኃ ጀምሮ ይህ ለእኔ ምስክር ነው፤ ቀድሞ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ምድርን እንዳልቈጣት እንደ ማልሁ፥
ተራሮችን እንዳልቀሥፋቸው እንዳላፈልሳቸውም፥ ኮረብቶችም እንዳይነዋወጡ እንደ ማልሁ እንዲሁ ከእኔ ዘንድ ያለሽ ይቅርታ አያልቅም፤ የሰላምሽ ቃል ኪዳንም አይጠፋም፤ መሓሪሽ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ተናግሮአልና።
አንቺ የተቸገርሽ የተናወጥሽ ያልተጽናናሽም፥ እነሆ፥ ድንጋዮችሽን የሚያበሩ አደርጋለሁ፤ መሠረትሽንም የሰንፔር አደርገዋለሁ።
ግንብሽንም በቀይ ዕንቍ፥ በሮችሽንም ቢረሌ በተባለ ዕንቍ፥ ዳርቻዎችሽንም በከበረ ዕንቍ እሠራለሁ።
ልጆችሽም ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር የተማሩ ይሆናሉ፤ ልጆችሽም በብዙ ሰላም ይኖራሉ።
እነሆ፥ በጽድቅ ትታነጺያለሽ፤ ከግፍ ራቂ፤ አትፈሪም፤ ድንጋጤም ወደ አንቺ አይቀርብም።
እነሆ፥ መጻተኞች በእኔ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፤ በአንቺም ይማጸናሉ።
እነሆ፥ ፍሙን በወናፍ እንደሚያናፋ፥ ለሥራውም መሣሪያ እንደሚያወጣ ብረት ሠሪ የፈጠርሁሽ አይደለም፤ እኔ ግን ለመልካም ፈጠርሁሽ እንጂ ለጥፋት አይደለም።
በአንቺ ላይ የተሠራ መሣሪያ ሁሉ እንዲከናወን አላደርግም፤ በአንቺ ላይ ለፍርድ የሚነሣውን ድምፅ ሁሉ ታጠፊያለሽ፤ ጠላቶችሽም ሁሉ ይፈረድባቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ለሚያገለግሉ ርስት አላቸው፤ ጻድቃኔም ትሆኑኛላችሁ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

sections.title: The mercy of the Lord.

verses.text: እናንተ የተጠማችሁ ሁሉ፥ ወደ ውኃ ሂዱ፤ ገንዘብም የሌላችሁ ሂዱና ግዙ፤ ብሉ፤ ያለ ገንዘብም ያለ ዋጋም የወይን ጠጅና ወተት ጠጡ።
ገንዘብን እንጀራ ላይደለ፥ የድካማችሁንም ዋጋ ለማያጠግብ ነገር ለምን ትመዝናላችሁ? አድምጡኝ፤ በረከትንም ብሉ፤ ሰውነታችሁም በበረከት ደስ ይበለው።
ስሙኝ፤ ጎዳናዬን ተከተሉ፤ አድምጡኝም፤ ሰውነታችሁም በበረከት ትኖራለች፤ የታመነችዪቱን የዳዊትን ምሕረት፥ የዘለዓለምን ቃል ኪዳን ከእናንተ ጋር አደርጋለሁ።
እነሆ፥ ለአሕዛብ ምስክር፥ ለወገኖችም አለቃና አዛዥ እንዲሆን አደረግሁት።
እነሆ፥ የማያውቁህ ሕዝብ ይጠሩሃል፤ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ አክብሮሃልና ስለ አምላክህ ስለ እግዚአብሔር የማያውቁህ ሕዝብ በአንተ ይማጠናሉ።
እግዚአብሔር በሚገኝበት ጊዜ ፈልጉት፤ ቀርቦም ሳለ ጥሩት፤
ክፉ ሰው መንገዱን፥ በደለኛም ዐሳቡን ይተው፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ይመለስ፤ እርሱም ይምረዋል፤ እርሱ ብዙ በደላችሁን ይተውላችኋልና።
ዐሳቤ እንደ ዐሳባችሁ፥ መንገዴም እንደ መንገዳችሁ አይደለምና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
ሰማይ ከምድር እንደሚርቅ፥ እንዲሁ መንገዴ ከመንገዳችሁ፥ ዐሳቤም ከዐሳባችሁ የራቀ ነው።
ብዙ ዝናምና በረዶ ከሰማይ እንደሚወርድ፥ ምድርን እንደሚያረካት፥ ታበቅልና ታፈራም ዘንድ እንደሚያደርጋት፥ ዘርን ለሚዘራ፥ እህልንም ለምግብ እንደሚሰጥ እንጂ ወደ ሰማይ እንደማይመለስ፥
The word that proceeds from My mouth is as follows: It shall not return to Me void until it has accomplished that which I desire; I shall establish My way and My command.
And you shall go forth with joy; you shall be led forth with peace; the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing; and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
For you shall go out in joy, and be led forth in peace; the mountains and the hills shall burst forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.

sections.title: All nations are as the people of the Lord God.

verses.text: The Lord saith, “The deliverer shall come, and My mercy shall be revealed; keep justice, and do righteousness.”
He who doeth this shall dwell in safety, and he shall keep the Sabbath and shall not profane it; he who keepeth his hand from doing any evil is a righteous man.
And let not the one who is a foreigner say, “Surely the Lord hath separated me from His people,” nor let the eunuch say, “Behold, I am a dry tree.”
The Lord saith unto the eunuchs, “If they keep My Sabbath and choose that which pleaseth Me, and hold fast to My covenant,”
I will give them a place and a name better than that of sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that shall not be cut off.

To those who have returned from other nations unto the Lord, and who are His servants, who have loved the name of the Lord, both men and women, “Those who keep My Sabbath and do not profane it, and who hold fast to My covenant,”

I will bring them to My holy mountain, and I will make them joyful in My house of prayer; for My house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples, and their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon My altar.
The Lord, who gathereth the outcasts of Israel, saith, “I will gather yet others to him besides those already gathered.”
Come, all ye beasts of the field; come, ye beasts of the forest.

Let us all be as the blind; they are all without knowledge; they are all as dogs that cannot bark; they cry out, yet they cannot prevail; in their sleep, they do not dream; they love to roll in the mire.
All are like dogs that do not bark; they are evil and cannot discern; each one follows his own way as he pleases.
Come, let us drink wine; let us indulge in strong drink; as it is today, so shall it be tomorrow; indeed, it shall be even more abundant than today.

sections.title: The idols of Israel shall be cast away as they have been forsaken.

verses.text: ጻድቅ ሰው እንደጠፋ አያችሁ፤ ይህንም በልባችሁ አላሰባችሁም፤ ጻድቃን ሰዎች ይወገዳሉ፤ ጻድቅም ከክፋት ፊት እንደ ተወገደ ማንም አያስተውልም።
መቃብሩ በሰላም ይሆናል፤ ከመካከልም ይወሰዳል።
እናንተ የኃጥኣን ልጆች፥ የዘማውያንና የጋለሞታዪቱ ዘር፥ ወደዚህ ቅረቡ።
በማን ታላግጣላችሁ? በማንስ ላይ አፋችሁን ታላቅቃላችሁ? ምላሳችሁንስ በማን ላይ ታስረዝማላችሁ?
እናንተ በለመለመ ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች በጣዖት ደስ የምትሰኙ፥ እናንተም በሸለቆች ውስጥ በዓለትም ስንጣቂዎች በታች ልጆቻችሁን የምትሠዉ፥ እናንተ የጥፋት ልጆችና የዐመፀኞች ዘሮች አይደላችሁምን?
በሸለቆ ውስጥ ያሉ የለዘቡ ድንጋዮች ዕድል ፋንታሽ ናቸው፤ እነርሱም ዕጣሽ ናቸው፤ ለእነርሱም የመጠጥ ቍርባን አፍስሰሻል፤ የእህልንም ቍርባን አቅርበሻል። እንግዲህ በዚህ ነገር አልቈጣምን?
ከፍ ባለውና በረዘመውም ተራራ ላይ መኝታሽን አደረግሽ፤ በዚያም መሥዋዕትሽን ሠዋሽ።
ከመዝጊያው በኋላ መታሰቢያሽን አደረግሽ፤ እኔን ብትተዪ የሚጠቅምሽ መሰለሽን? ከእኔም ይልቅ ከአንቺ ጋራ የሚተኙትን መረጥሽ።
ዝሙትሽን ከእነርሱ ጋር አበዛሽ፤ ከአንቺ የራቁ ብዙዎችንም ተጐዳኘሽ። መልእክተኞችሽንም ወደ ሩቅ ላክሽ፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ተወገድሽ፤ እስከ ሲኦልም ድረስ ተዋረድሽ።
በመንገድሽም ብዛት ደከምሽ፤ ዳግመኛም ጕልበት እያለኝ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ይህን መንገድ አልተውም አላልሽም፤ ይህንም ስላደረግሽ አላፈርሽም።
ሐሰት የተናገርሽው፥ እኔንም ያላሰብሽው፥ በልብሽም ነገሩን ያላኖርሽው ማንን ሰግተሽ ነው? ማንንስ ፈርተሽ ነው? እኔም ዝም አልሁሽ፤ አንቺም አልፈራሽኝም።
እንግዲህ እኔ ጽድቄንና የማይረባሽን የአንቺን በደል እናገራለሁ።
በችግርሽ ቀን በጮኽሽ ጊዜ እስኪ ይታደጉሽ፤ እነሆ፥ ዐውሎ ይወስዳቸዋል፤ ነፋስም ሁሉን ያስወግዳቸዋል። ወደ እኔ የሚጠጉ ግን ምድሪቱን ይገዛሉ፤ የተቀደሰውን ተራራዬንም ይወርሳሉ።
እርሱም፥ “በፊቱ፥ መንገድን ጥረጉ፤ ከሕዝቤም መንገድ ዕንቅፋትን አስወግዱ” ይላል።
ለዘለዓለም በአርያም የሚኖር ስሙም ቅዱሰ ቅዱሳን የሆነ፥ በቅዱሳን አድሮ የሚኖር፥ ለተዋረዱት ትዕግሥትን የሚሰጥ፥ ልባቸውም ለተቀጠቀጠ ሕይወትን የሚሰጥ ልዑል እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦
“መንፈስ ከእኔ ይወጣልና፥ የሁሉንም ነፍስ ፈጥሬአለሁና ለዘለዓለም አልቀስፋችሁም፤ ሁልጊዜም አልቈጣችሁም።
ስለ ኀጢአቱ ጥቂት ጊዜ መከራ አመጣሁበት፤ ቀሠፍሁትም፤ ፊቴንም ከእርሱ መለስሁ፤ እርሱም አዘነ። እያዘነም ሄደ።
ከዚህም በኋላ መንገዱን አይቻለሁ፤ ፈወስሁትም፤ አጽናናሁት፤ እውነተኛ ደስታንም ሰጠሁት።
በሩቅም በቅርብም ላሉ በሰላም ላይ ሰላም ይሁን፤ እፈውሳቸውማለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
“ኃጥኣን ግን እንዲህ ይገለበጣሉ፤ ዕረፍትንም አያገኙም።
"They have no joy for the wicked," saith the Lord.

sections.title: Concerning true fasting.

verses.text: Cry out with Thy strength; do not hold back; let Thy voice be heard like that of an angel; declare the iniquities of my people, and the transgressions of the house of Jacob.

Yet, as the Lord executes righteousness, so shall the people not be forsaken; day by day they shall seek Him; they shall love the way of the Lord, for they know it. Even now, they shall call upon the true judgment; they shall desire to draw near unto the Lord.

"Why do you fast, and you do not regard us? Why do you afflict our bodies, and you do not know us?" Thus they say. Behold, on the day of your fast, you do as you please, and you oppress all your laborers.

Behold, you fast for strife and debate; you strike with the fist of wickedness; you fast not as you do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high. Is it such a fast that I have chosen, a day for a man to afflict his soul?

This fast that I have chosen is not as you think; on such a day, if a man afflicts his soul, and if he bows down his head like a bulrush, and spreads sackcloth and ashes under him, this fast shall not be accepted before the Lord.
"This fast that I have chosen is not as you say," saith the Lord; "but rather, loose the bonds of wickedness; undo the heavy burdens; let the oppressed go free; and break every yoke."
Share your bread with the hungry, and bring the poor that are cast out to your house; when you see the naked, cover him; and do not hide yourself from your own flesh.
Then shall your light break forth as the morning, and your healing shall spring forth speedily; and your righteousness shall go before you; the glory of the Lord shall be your rear guard.
Then shall you call, and the Lord shall answer; you shall cry, and He shall say, "Here I am." If you take away the yoke from your midst, the pointing of the finger, and speaking wickedness,
And if you extend your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then shall your light rise in obscurity, and your darkness shall be as the noonday.

And the Lord shall always dwell with thee; as thy soul hath desire, so shall He satisfy thee; He shall preserve thy bones; and thou shalt be as a fountain of water that shall not be diminished, even as a garden that drinketh deeply.

The places which were forsaken from old shall be rebuilt; thy foundation shall endure for generations to come; and thou shalt say: "I will restore the desolate places, and I shall call forth a new way of habitation."

If thou turnest thy foot from the holy day, from doing thy pleasure on My holy day, and callest the sabbath a delight, the holy of the Lord, honorable; and shalt honor Him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words;

In that time, thou shalt trust in the Lord; and He shall bring forth blessings upon the earth; He shall give thee the inheritance of thy father Jacob; for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken these things.

sections.title: The sin of the people has been laid upon Him.

verses.text: Truly, can the hand of the Lord not save? Is His ear not able to hear?
However, your iniquities have separated you from your God, and your sins have hidden His face from you, so that He will not hear.
Your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers are filled with iniquity; your lips have spoken falsehood, and your tongue mutters wickedness.
There is no one who speaks righteousness and no one who judges in truth; they trust in empty words and speak lies; they conceive mischief and bring forth iniquity.
They hatch the eggs of vipers and weave the spider's web; he who eats of their eggs dies, and from that which is crushed, a viper breaks out.
The garments of spiders are not clothing; they cannot cover themselves with their works; their deeds are deeds of iniquity.
Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood; their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; desolation and destruction are in their paths.
They do not know the way of peace, and there is no justice in their paths; they have made their roads crooked; no one who walks in them knows peace.
Therefore, justice is far from them, and righteousness does not overtake them; they hope for light, but behold, darkness; for brightness, but they walk in gloom.
Like blind men, they grope along the wall; they stumble like those without eyes; at midday, they stumble as in the twilight; among the strong, they are like dead men.
As a bear and as a lion, they shall walk in unity; judgment was to be upheld; there is no deliverer; it is far from us.
Our transgressions have risen before Thee, and our iniquities have testified against us; our transgressions are with us, and we know not righteousness.

We have been led astray; we have been deceived; our God we have forsaken; our transgressions we have spoken of; we have turned away from our sins; we have uttered the words of iniquity from our hearts.
Judgment has been set far behind; righteousness stands at a distance; truth has been taken away from their paths; they are unable to walk in a straight way.
They have turned away from the truth; their hearts have been hardened so that they do not perceive. The Lord has not seen; and because there is no judgment, He takes no delight.
There is no man to see; there is no one to help; therefore, they have been crushed under the burden; by His mercy, they have been preserved.
Righteousness has been clothed as with a garment; upon Himself, He has placed the helmet of salvation; He has donned the robe of righteousness.
He has delivered them from their enemies, and the garment of salvation and the mantle of righteousness has been bestowed.
Those in the west shall fear the name of the Lord, and those at the rising of the sun shall tremble at His glory. The wrath of the Lord shall come forth like a mighty flood.
From Zion shall the Redeemer come; and from Jacob shall He turn away transgression.

"This is the covenant that I make with them," saith the Lord; "My Spirit that is upon thee, and My words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, from henceforth and forever," saith the Lord.

sections.title: The glory of the future Jerusalem.

verses.text: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ብርሃንሽ መጥቶአልና፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ብርሃን በአንቺ ላይ ወጥቶአልና አብሪ፤ አብሪ።
እነሆ፥ ጨለማ ምድርን፥ ድቅድቅ ጨለማም አሕዛብን ይሸፍናል፤ ነገር ግን በአንቺ ላይ እግዚአብሔር ይገለጣል፤ ክብሩም በአንቺ ላይ ይታያል፤
ነገሥታት በብርሃንሽ፥ አሕዛብም በፀዳልሽ ይሄዳሉ።
ዐይኖችሽን አንሥተሽ በዙሪያሽ ተመልከቺ፤ ልጆችሽም እንደ ተሰበሰቡ እነሆ፥ እዪ፤ ወንዶች ልጆችሽ ከሩቅ ይመጣሉ፤ ሴቶች ልጆችሽንም በጫንቃ ላይ ይሸከሙአቸዋል።
በዚያ ጊዜ አይተሽ ትፈሪያለሽ፤ የአሕዛብና የሀገሮች ብልጽግና ወደ አንቺ ይመለሳልና፥ ልብሽ ይደነግጣል።
የግመሎች መንጋ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፤ የምድያምና የኤፋ ግመሎች ይሸፍኑሻል፤ ሁሉ ከሳባ ወርቅንና ዕጣንን ይዘው ይመጣሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ማዳን ያበሥራሉ።
የቄዳር በጎች ሁሉ ወደ አንቺ ይሰበሰባሉ፤ የነባዮትም አውራ በጎች ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፤ በመሠዊያዬ ላይም የተመረጠው መሥዋዕት ይቀርባል፤ የጸሎቴ ቤትም ይከብራል።
እንደ ደመና፥ ከጫጩቶችዋ ጋር ወደ መስኮቷ እንደምትገባ ርግብም የሚበርሩ እነዚህ እነማን ናቸው?
ደሴቶች እኔን ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ፤ የተርሴስም መርከቦች አስቀድመው ይመጣሉ፤ ልጆችሽ ስለ ከበረው ስለ እስራኤል ቅዱስ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ስም ወርቅና ብር ይዘው ከሩቅ ሀገር ይመጣሉ።
በቍጣዬ ቀሥፌ በይቅርታዬ አቅርቤሻለሁና መጻተኞች ቅጥርሽን ይሠራሉ፤ ነገሥታቶቻቸውም በፊትሽ ይቆማሉ።
በሮችሽም ሁልጊዜ ይከፈታሉ፤ ሰዎች የአሕዛብን ብልጽግና፥ የተማረኩትንም ነገሥታቶቻቸውን ወደ አንቺ ያመጡ ዘንድ ሌሊትና ቀን አይዘጉም።
ለአንቺም የማይገዙ ነገሥታት ይሞታሉ፤ እነዚያም አሕዛብ ፈጽመው ይጠፋሉ።
የመቅደሴንም ስፍራ ያከብሩ ዘንድ የሊባኖስ ክብር፥ ጥዱና አስታው፥ ባርሰነቱም ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፥
የአስጨናቂዎችሽም ልጆች እየተንቀጠቀጡ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፤ የናቁሽም ሁሉ ወደ እግርሽ ጫማ ይሰግዳሉ፤ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ የእግዚአብሔር ከተማ፥ ጽዮን ተብለሽም ትጠሪያለሽ።
የተተውሽና የተጠላሽ ሆነሻልና የሚረዳሽ አጣሽ፤ ነገር ግን የዘለዓለም ደስታን ለልጅ ልጅ እሰጥሻለሁ።
የአሕዛብንም ወተት ትጠጫለሽ፤ የነገሥታትንም ብልጽግና ትበያለሽ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤል ቅዱስ፥ መድኀኒትሽና ታዳጊሽ እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቂያለሽ።
በናስ ፋንታ ወርቅን፥ በብረትም ፋንታ ብርን፥ በእንጨትም ፋንታ ናስን፥ በድንጋይም ፋንታ ብረትን እሰጥሻለሁ። ለአለቆችሽም ሰላምን፥ ለመኳንንትሽም ፍርድን አደርጋለሁ፤
እንግዲህ በምድርሽ ውስጥ ግፍ፥ በዳርቻሽም ውስጥ ጕስቍልናና ቅጥቃጤ አይሰማም፤ ቅጥሮችሽ ድኅነት ይባላሉ፤ በሮችሽም በጥርብ ድንጋይ ይሠራሉ።
ፀሐይ በቀን የሚያበራልሽ አይደለም፤ በሌሊትም ጨረቃ የሚወጣልሽ አይደለም፤ ለአንቺስ እግዚአብሔር የዘለዓለም ብርሃንሽ፥ አምላክሽም ክብርሽ ይሆናል።
እግዚአብሔር የዘለዓለም ብርሃንሽ ይሆናልና፥ የልቅሶሽም ወራት ያልፋልና፤ ፀሐይሽ ከዚህ በኋላ አትጠልቅም፤ ጨረቃሽም አይቋረጥም።
Thy people shall all be righteous; they shall inherit the land forever; they shall keep the work of their hands to give thanks unto Him.
The little one shall become a thousand, and the smallest a mighty nation; I, the Lord, will hasten it in its time.

sections.title: The Good News of Salvation

verses.text: የጌታ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ ነው፤ ለድሆች የምሥራችን እሰብክ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ቀብቶኛልና፤ ልባቸው የተሰበረውን እጠግን ዘንድ፥ ለተማረኩትም ነጻነትን፥ ለታሰሩትም መፈታትን፥ ለዕውራንም ማየትን እናገር ዘንድ ልኮኛል።
የተወደደችውን የእግዚአብሔርንም ዓመት የተመረጠች ብዬ እጠራት ዘንድ፥ አምላካችንም የሚበቀልበትን ቀን እናገር ዘንድ፥ የሚያለቅሱትንም ሁሉ አጽናና ዘንድ፥
እግዚአብሔር ለክብሩ የተከላቸው የጽድቅ ዛፎች እንዲባሉ ለጽዮን አልቃሾች አደርግላቸው ዘንድ፥ በአመድም ፋንታ አክሊልን፥ በልቅሶም ፋንታ የደስታን ዘይት፥ በኀዘንም መንፈስ ፋንታ የምስጋናን መጐናጸፊያ እሰጣቸው ዘንድ ልኮኛል።
ከጥንት ጀምሮ የፈረሱትን ይሠራሉ፤ ከቀድሞ ጀምሮ የፈረሱትንም ያቆማሉ፤ ባድማ የነበሩትንና ከብዙ ትውልድ በፊት የፈረሱትን ከተሞች እንደ ገና ያድሳሉ።
መጻተኞችም መጥተው በጎቻችሁን ይጠብቃሉ፥ ሌሎች ወገኖችም አራሾችና ወይን ጠባቂዎች ይሆኑላችኋል።
እናንተ ግን የእግዚአብሔር ካህናት ትባላላችሁ፤ የአምላካችንም አገልጋዮች ተብላችሁ ትጠራላችሁ፤ የአሕዛብን ሀብት ትበላላችሁ፤ በሀብታቸውም ትመካላችሁ።
ሌላ ምድርን ይወርሳሉ፤ በራሳቸውም ዘለዓለማዊ ደስታ አላቸው።
እኔ እግዚአብሔር ጽድቅን የምወድድ፥ ስርቆትንና ቅሚያን የምጠላ ነኝ፤ እንደ ሥራቸውም ለጻድቃን እከፍላቸዋለሁ፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር የዘለዓለምን ቃል ኪዳን አደርጋለሁ።
ዘራቸው በአሕዛብ መካከል፥ ልጆቻቸውም በወገኖች መካከል የታወቁ ይሆናሉ፤ ያያቸው ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር የባረካቸው ዘር እንደ ሆኑ ያውቃል፤
በእግዚአብሔርም እጅግ ደስ ይላቸዋል። ነፍሴም በእግዚአብሔር ሐሤት ታደርጋለች። ሽልማትን እንደ ለበሰ ሙሽራ፥ በጌጥ ሽልማቷም እንዳጌጠች ሙሽራ፥ የማዳንን ልብስ አልብሶኛልና፥ የደስታንም መጐናጸፊያ ደርቦልኛልና።

For as the earth brings forth its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord God will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
ጽድቄ እንደ ብርሃን፥ ማዳኔም እንደሚበራ ፋና እስኪወጣ ድረስ ስለ ጽዮን ዝም አልልም፤ ስለ ኢየሩሳሌምም ጸጥ አልልም።
አሕዛብ ጽድቅሽን፥ ነገሥታትም ሁሉ ክብርሽን ያያሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም አፍ በሚጠራበት በአዲሱ ስም ትጠሪያለሽ።
በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ያማረ አክሊል፥ በአምላክሽም እጅ የመንግሥት ዘውድ ትሆኛለሽ።
ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ፥ “የተተወች” አትባዪም፤ ምድርሽም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ፥ “ውድማ” አትባልም፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር በአንቺ ደስ ብሎታልና፥ ምድርሽም ባል ታገባለችና አንቺ፥ “ደስታዬ የሚኖርባት” ትባያለሽ፤ ምድርሽም፥ “ባል ያገባች” ትባላለች።
ጐልማሳም ከድንግሊቱ ጋር እንደሚኖር፥ እንዲሁ ልጆችሽ ከአንቺ ጋር ይኖራሉ፤ ሙሽራም በሙሽራዪቱ ደስ እንደሚለው፥ እንዲሁ አምላክሽ በአንቺ ደስ ይለዋል።
ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ጠባቂዎችሽን በቅጥርሽ ላይ ቀንና ሌሊት አቁሜአለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርን የሚያስቡ ከቶ ዝም አይሉም፤
ኢየሩሳሌምን እስኪያጸና፥ በምድርም ላይ ምስጋና እስኪያደርጋት ድረስ ዝም አትበሉ።
እግዚአብሔር፥ “ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በእርግጥ ለጠላቶችሽ መብል ይሆን ዘንድ እህልሽን አልሰጥም፥ መጻተኞችም የደከምሽበትን ወይንሽን አይጠጡም፤” ብሎ በጌትነቱና በክንዱ ኀይል ምሎአል።
ነገር ግን የሰበሰቡት ይበሉታል፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ያመሰግናሉ፤ ያከማቹትንም ወይን በመቅደሴ አደባባይ ላይ ይጠጡታል።
ሂዱና በበሬ ውስጥ ግቡ፤ ለሕዝቤም መንገድን ጥረጉ፤ ድንጋዮቹንም ከጎዳናው አስወግዱ፤ ለአሕዛብም አላማ ያዙ።
Behold, the Lord hath spoken unto the earth, saying, "To the daughter of Zion: Behold, thy Savior cometh; lo, his reward is with him, and his work is before him."
The Lord saith, "They shall be called, 'My people, the holy ones who are beloved'; and thou shalt be called, 'A city not forsaken, a beloved city.'"

sections.title: The victory of the Philistines.

verses.text: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? This that is glorious in his apparel, traveling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
Why is thy apparel red, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?

I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.

sections.title: The mercy of the Lord is for Israel.

verses.text: In every gift, I shall remember the mercy of the Lord and the praise of the Lord; for the Lord is a true refuge for Israel and its children; as His mercy and His righteousness are abundant, He shall bring forth forgiveness.
And He said, "Is not my people children? If they cry out to Me, I will deliver them from all their afflictions."

Neither is He a messenger; nor is He an angel; He Himself shall deliver them. For He loves them, and He shall comfort them, and He shall take them under His protection; He shall receive them, and in all their times, He shall honor them forever.
Yet they perished; they grieved the Holy Spirit; therefore, they returned and became enemies; and He fought against them.
And He thought of the ancient times, saying, "When the good shepherd led them out of Egypt, I sent My angel before them."
"And with Moses, I struck the rock with My right hand; and the water gushed forth before them, and He did great things in the name of the everlasting."
As a horse runs in the wilderness, so He led them forth; they did not stumble.
As the cattle descend to the valley, so the Spirit of the Lord brought them to rest; thus, you shall honor the name that is exalted for yourself, to lead your people.

sections.title: A prayer offered for the attainment of mercy and help.
