verses.text: Return from heaven; look upon the place of Thy holiness and of Thy glory; where is Thy righteousness and Thy power? Where is the multitude of Thy mercy and Thy forgiveness? For we have called upon Thee.
Thou art our Father; yet Abraham we have not known; and Israel we have not acknowledged; but Thou, O Lord, art our Father; deliver us; Thy name is upon us forever.
O Lord, why hast Thou caused us to stray from Thy way? And why hast Thou hardened our hearts from fearing Thee? Return for the sake of Thy servants, for the sake of the tribes of Thine inheritance.
Let us find a small portion of Thy inheritance upon Thy holy mountain.
As we have not been sold from of old, so let not Thy name be called upon us.
If You open the heavens, the mountains that rise up from You shall tremble; they shall quake.
As fire consumes the stubble before it, so shall Your enemies be consumed by fire; Your name shall be known among them; nations shall tremble before You.
When You perform the work of Your glory, the mountains shall quake before You.
From ancient times, we have not seen another god besides You who shows mercy to those who wait for Your forgiveness; we have not heard of any.
In Your goodness, those who seek Your ways shall find You; behold, You are angry, and we have sinned; therefore, we have been led astray.
All of us have become like one who is unclean; and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment; because of our sins, we have withered like leaves; and the wind has carried us away.
There is none who calls upon Your name, who stirs himself to take hold of You; for You have hidden Your face from us, and have delivered us into the hand of our iniquities.
But now, O Lord, You are our Father; we are the clay, and You are our potter; and we are all the work of Your hand.
O Lord, do not be angry beyond measure; do not remember our iniquities forever; now, please look upon us, for we are all Your people.
Your holy cities have become a wilderness; Zion has become a wilderness, and Jerusalem a desolation.
Our fathers have honored Thy glory; Thy sanctuary hath been consumed by fire, and our pleasant place hath been laid waste.
O Lord, in all these matters, Thou hast been our refuge; we have not been silent; indeed, Thou hast greatly humbled us.

sections.title: The Lord shall punish the wicked as He sees fit.

verses.text: ያልፈለጉኝ አገኙኝ፤ ላልጠየቁኝም ተገኘሁ፤ ስሜን ላልጠራ ሕዝብ፥ “እነሆኝ” አልሁት።
በጽድቅ መንገድ ወደማይሄዱ፥ ኀጢአታቸውን ወደሚከተሉ ዐመፀኞች ሕዝብ ቀኑን ሁሉ እጆችን ዘረጋሁ።
እኒህ ሕዝብ ዘወትር የሚያስቈጡኝ ናቸው፤ እነርሱ በአትክልት ውስጥ የሚሠዉ በጡብም ላይ ለአጋንንት የሚያጥኑ፥
በመቃብርም መካከል የሚተኙ፥ በዋሻ ውስጥ የሚያልሙ፥ የእሪያ ሥጋም የሚበሉ ናቸው። የመሥዋዕታቸውን ደምና ዕቃቸውንም ሁሉ ያረክሳሉ።
“እኔ ንጹሕ ነኝና ከእኔ ራቁ፥ ወደ እኔም አትቅረቡ” ይላሉ። ስለዚህም የቍጣዬ ጢስ በዘመኑ ሁሉ እንደ እሳት ይነድድባቸዋል።
እነሆ፥ በፊቴ ተጽፎአል፦ ኀጢአቶቻችሁንና የአባቶቻችሁን ኀጢአት በአንድ ላይ ወደ ብብታቸው ፍዳ አድርጌ እመልሳለሁ እንጂ ዝም አልልም፤ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤
በተራሮችም ላይ ስላጠኑ፥ በኮረብቶችም ላይ ስለ አሽሟጠጡኝ ስለዚህ አስቀድመው የሠሩትን ሥራቸውን በብብታቸው እሰፍራለሁ።
እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “የወይን ፍሬ በዘለላው በተገኘች ጊዜ፦ በረከት በእርስዋ ላይ አለና አታጥፉት እንደሚባለው፥ ሁሉን እንዳላጠፋ ስለ ባሪያዎች እንዲህ አደርጋለሁ።
የያዕቆብን ዘርና የይሁዳን ዘር አመጣለሁ፤ የተቀደሰው ተራራዬንም ይወርሳሉ፤ እኔ የመረጥኋቸውና ባሪያዎችም ይወርሱአታል፤ በዚያም ይኖራሉ።
በመንጋው መሰማሪያና በዛፍ መካከል በአኮር ሸለቆና በቆላውም የላሞች መመሰግያ ለፈለጉኝ ሕዝቤ ይሆናል።
"But you have forsaken me; you have forgotten my holy mountain, and you have prepared a table for the goddess of fortune, and you have mixed wine for the drink offering to the chosen idol."

"I also will prepare a sword for you; and all of you shall fall by the sword; you have done evil in my sight, and have chosen that in which I did not delight; and when I called you, you did not answer me, and when I spoke to you, you did not listen."

"Therefore, thus says the Lord God: 'Behold, my servants shall eat, but you shall be hungry; behold, my servants shall drink, but you shall be thirsty; behold, my servants shall rejoice, but you shall be ashamed.'"
"Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but you shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall wail for vexation of spirit."
"I will choose for them, and they shall be called by my name; but you shall be cast out, says the Lord God, and my servants shall be called by a new name."

"Thus shall they be blessed upon the earth; for they shall give thanks to the true God, and upon the earth they shall call upon the true God; for the former troubles are forgotten, and they shall not remember them in their heart."
"Behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind."
"But in her shall be joy and gladness; and I will rejoice in Jerusalem and joy in my people."
"And I will rejoice in Jerusalem; and my people shall find joy in her; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying shall no longer be heard in her."

"There shall no longer be found in it an infant who lives but a few days, nor an old man who does not fill out his days; for the young man shall die a hundred years old, and the sinner being a hundred years old shall be accursed."
They shall build houses; they shall dwell in them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

They shall not build for another to dwell in; they shall not plant for another to eat; for the days of my people shall be as the days of a tree, and my chosen ones shall enjoy the work of their hands for a long time.
For they are the offspring of the children of the Lord, and they shall not labor in vain; nor shall they bear children for trouble.
"And it shall be thus; before they call, I will answer them; while they are yet speaking, behold, I will hear."

At that time, the wolf and the lamb shall feed together; the lion shall eat straw like the ox; and dust shall be the serpent's food. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain," says the Lord.

sections.title: The Lord shall judge among the nations.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “ሰማይ ዙፋኔ ነው፤ ምድርም የእግሬ መረገጫ ናት፤ የምትሠሩልኝ ቤት ምን ዓይነት ነው? የማርፍበትስ ስፍራ ምንድን ነው?
ይህ ሁሉ የእጄ ሥራ ነው፤ ይህም ሁሉ የእኔ ነው፥” ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ “ወደ የዋሁና ወደ ጸጥተኛው፥ ከቃሌም የተነሣ ወደሚንቀጠቀጥ ሰው ከአልሆነ በቀር ወደ ማን እመለከታለሁ?
በሬን የሚሠዋልኝ ኃጥእ ውሻን እንደሚያርድልኝ ነው፤ የእህልን ቍርባን የሚያቀርብም የእሪያን ደም እንደሚያቀርብ ነው፤ ዕጣንንም ለመታሰቢያ የሚያጥን አምላክን እንደሚፀርፍ ነው፤ እነዚህ የገዛ መንገዳቸውን መረጡ፤ ነፍሳቸውም በርኵሰታቸው ደስ ይላታል።
እኔ ግን አዋርዳቸው ዘንድ፥ ስለ ኀጢአታቸውም እበቀላቸው ዘንድ እፈቅዳለሁ፤ እኔ በጠራሁ ጊዜ አልመለሱልኝምና፥ በተናገርሁም ጊዜ አልሰሙኝም፤ በፊቴም ክፉ ነገርን አደረጉ፤ ያልወደድሁትንም መረጡ።”
በቃሉ የምትንቀጠቀጡ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፥ “የእግዚአብሔር ስም ይከብር ዘንድ፦ ደስታችሁም ይገለጥ ዘንድ፥ እነርሱም ያፍሩ ዘንድ የሚጠሏችሁንና የሚጸየፉአችሁን ወንድሞቻችን በሏቸው።
የጩኸት ድምፅ ከከተማ፥ ድምፅም ከመቅደስ፥ በጠላቶቹም ላይ ፍዳን የሚያመጣ የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።
“ሳታምጥ ወለደች፤ ምጥም ሳያገኛት ወንድ ልጅን ወለደች።
ከቶ እንዲህ ያለ ነገርን ማን ሰምቶአል? እንዲህስ ያለ ነገርን ማን አይቶአል? በውኑ ሀገር በአንድ ቀን ታምጣለችን? ወይስ በአንድ ጊዜ ሕዝብ ይወለዳልን? ጽዮን እንዳማጠች ወዲያው ልጆችዋን ወልዳለችና።
እኔ ተስፋን ሰጠሁሽ፤ አንቺ ግን አላሰብሽኝም ይላል እግዚአብሔር። ሴት እንድትወልድ፥ መካንም እንዳትሆን የማደርግ እኔ አይደለሁምን?” ይላል አምላክሽ።
ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ ደስ ይበልሽ፤ እርስዋንም የምትወድዱአት ሁሉ፥ በአንድነት ሐሤት አድርጉ፤ ስለ እርስዋም ያለቀሳችሁ ሁሉ፥ ከእርስዋ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ፤
You shall be comforted as a mother comforts her child; you shall rejoice in her glory, for she shall fill you with great delight.

Thus saith the Lord God, “Behold, I will bring peace like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream; and you shall be carried upon her hip, and upon her knees shall you be dandled.”
As a mother comforts her child, so will I comfort you; and you shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
You shall see, and your heart shall rejoice; and your bones shall flourish like the grass; and the hand of the Lord shall be known to His servants, and His indignation toward His enemies.

Behold, the Lord shall come with fire, and His chariots like a whirlwind, to render His anger with fury, and His rebuke with flames of fire; for by fire will the Lord execute judgment, and by His sword upon all flesh, and the slain of the Lord shall be many.
For the earth shall be consumed by the fire of the Lord, and all mankind shall be as stubble; and those who are slain by the Lord shall be multiplied.

“In the place of the vine, they shall be consumed and cleansed; in the place of food, they shall not eat the flesh of swine, nor any abominable thing; they shall be consumed in unity,” saith the Lord.
“I have seen their works and their thoughts; behold, I will come, and I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come and see My glory.”

And I will set a sign among them; and those among them who escape shall be sent to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, to draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the coastlands afar off, who have not heard My fame nor seen My glory; and they shall declare My glory among the nations.

Just as the children of Israel bring their offerings in a clean vessel to the house of the Lord, so shall your brethren bring offerings unto the Lord, of horses and chariots, of tents and vessels, upon the clean beasts; they shall bring them to the holy city, to Jerusalem, saith the Lord.
"And I will take from them priests and Levites," saith the Lord God.
"Behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind," saith the Lord God.
"Thus shall it be: at every appointed time and on every Sabbath, the flesh of all sacrifices shall be offered before me in Jerusalem, and it shall continually come," saith the Lord God.
"And those who have transgressed against me shall see their shame; they shall not die, nor shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an example for all flesh," saith the Lord.
